texts.g:f7c5d0c2: Umbiko wocwaningo lokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Ukwaneliseka konyaka kwakungamaphuzu angu-78, amaphuzu angu-4 aphezulu kunalawo angu-74 onyaka odlule. Kodwa kulo nyaka indlela yokuqasha abaphendulile yashintshwa isuka kocingweni yaya ku-inthanethi, futhi isabelo sabantu abaneminyaka engu-20 no-30 phakathi kwabaphendulile be-inthanethi saba kabili salo onyaka odlule. Leli qembu leminyaka liyiqembu elaniketha amaphuzu aphezulu kunephakathi nakucwaningo olwedlule. Ngakho, ukuthi ukukhuphuka kungumphumela wokuthuthuka kwangempela kwenkonzo kungakanani kunzima ukukwahlulela kusuka kudatha yamanje. Siphakamisa ukuthi ucwaningo olulandelayo luqhathanise nezabelo zeminyaka ezifanisiwe neze-onyaka odlule.
texts.g:e13c0f5b: Umbono wokubuyekeza ngemiphumela yohlelo lokusekela amabhizinisi amancane endawo. Ukuthengisa okuphakathi kwenyanga kwamabhizinisi angamashumi amathathu asekelwayo kukhuphuke ngamaphesenti angu-18 uma kuqhathaniswa nangaphambi kokuqala kohlelo. Kodwa uma ubheka ibhizinisi ngalinye, amabhizinisi amabili abone ukuthengisa kukhuphuka ngaphezu kokuphindwe kathathu futhi angamashumi amabili nanye ehle kancane ngempela. Ngaphandle kwala mabili, izinga eliphakathi lokukhula lehla kakhulu. Umnyango obhekele uhlelo wanquma ukuthi lusebenza ngokuphelele, kodwa ngokubheka izibalo ezingenhla, ubufakazi obusekela leso siphetho abwanele.
texts.g:700e4ddd: Umbiko wokuphepha emigwaqweni endaweni yokubusa. Izingozi zomgwaqo zalo nyaka zazingu-1,200, ukukhuphuka ngamaphesenti angu-6 kusukela konyaka odlule, kodwa inani lezimoto ezibhalisiwe ngesikhathi esifanayo likhuphuke ngamaphesenti angu-11. Uma kuguqulelwa ezingozini ngezimoto ezingu-10,000, empeleni sekwehlile. Kodwa-ke, ukufa kusezingeni elifanayo nonyaka odlule, ngakho kunzima ukusho ukuthi umphumela wezinga eliphansi lezingozi welulekele ekwehleni kwezingozi ezinzima. Umbiko uncoma ukuhumusha izinkomba zenani nezobukhulu bezingozi ngokwahlukana.
texts.g:901fbaeb: Ngokombiko wesikhungo socwaningo, eminyakeni emihlanu edlule kwavela inkambiso yokuthi izinga lobugebengu bentsha lehle emadolobheni nasezifundeni lapho kwanda khona amalayibhrari. Kodwa umbiko awuphetheli ngokuthi lokhu kungumphumela wokwandiswa kwamalayibhrari, futhi uphinde ukhulume ngokwenzeka kokuthi okuguquguqukayo okubili kuhlobene nezimo zezimali zesifunda. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izifunda ezinezimali ezanele zandise hhayi kuphela amalayibhrari kodwa nezinhlelo zangemva kwesikole. Isikhungo sengeze ukuthi ukuze kuqinisekiswe umthelela ozimele wokwandiswa kwamalayibhrari, izifunda ezinezimo zezimali ezifanayo kumele ziqhathaniswe.
texts.g:3ca56d36: Imiphumela yenhlolovo yemibono yezakhamuzi iyafingqwa. Kuphrojekthi okukhulunywa ngayo, ukwesekwa kwakungamaphesenti angama-62, ukuphikiswa kwakungama-31, futhi abangaphenduli bengama-7. Kodwa-ke, izinga lokuphendula lalingamaphesenti angu-4 kuphela, futhi abaphenduli abaneminyaka engama-65 noma ngaphezulu, ngama-52 ekhulwini, badlula kakhulu isabelo sabo sangempela sabantu esingama-24 ekhulwini. Ithimba locwaningo liphinde labonisa amanani alungisiwe ukuze izabelo zeminyaka zifane nokwakheka kwabantu kwangempela; ngemva kokulungiswa, ukwesekwa kwehle kwaya kuma-54 ekhulwini kodwa kwakusewukuphezulu kunokuphikiswa. Ithimba lathi isiqondiso sokuthi abasekela baphambili siyagcinwa, kodwa umehluko kufanele uhunyushwe njengomncane kunamanani okuqala.
texts.g:98ee0f8a: Umbiko wemiphumela yokusebenza yekota yesithathu. Inzuzo ecacile yayingama-won ayizigidi eziyinkulungwane ezingu-12, ukukhula okungaba amaphesenti angama-35 kusukela esikhathini esifanayo sonyaka odlule. Kodwa-ke, ama-won ayizigidi ezingu-2,500 alokhu kuyinzuzo ethengiswe kanye kuphela ngokuthengisa isiza esingasetshenziswa. Uma lokhu kukhishwa, izinga lokukhula kwenzuzo ecacile lihlala ezinombolweni ezingaphansi kwesishumi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inzuzo yokusebenza, ebonisa inzuzo yebhizinisi eliyinhloko lokuthengisa imikhiqizo, yehle ngamaphesenti ama-2. Ithimba lezezimali linquma ukuthi ukufunda ukwenyuka kwenzuzo ecacile njengophawu lokuthi ibhizinisi liyathuthuka kusekuphambi kwesikhathi. Lokhu kuhlolwa kuzobuyekezwa ngemva kokuhlolwa ukuthi isakhiwo esifanayo siyaphindeka yini ikota ezayo.
texts.g:67ee002c: Umbiko wezinkambiso zemakethe yezindlu zenyanga ngenyanga. Inani lokuthengiswa kwamafulethi enyangeni ngalinye esifundeni sasenhloko lenyuke ngamaphesenti ama-3 kusukela enyangeni edlule, kodwa uma kubhekwa ukugeleza kwezinyanga ezintathu zokugcina empeleni kusesigabeni esiqondile. Inkomba yamanani nayo yenyuke ngamaphesenti angu-0.2 kuphela, okungabonwa njengoshintsho ngaphakathi komkhawulo wephutha. Khona-ke, kunemibiko evela embonini yabaphakathi ukuthi imibuzo yenyuke ngemuva kokunqanyulwa kwenzalo yezimalimboleko, kodwa lokhu kukakaqinisekiswa ezibalweni zokuthengiswa. Ngakho-ke umbiko uthatha isikhundla sokuthi kusenesikhathi sokuthi kuthiwe imakethe ingene esigabeni sokululama.
texts.g:e7f9a5a1: Isikhungo socwaningo sahlola abasebenzi basehhovisi abangu-1,200: abaphendulile abasebenza ekhaya okungenani kabili ngesonto babike ukwaneliseka komsebenzi okumaphakathi kwamaphuzu angu-78, okuphezulu kunamaphuzu angu-65 abasebenzi basehhovisi. Ngokusekelwe kulokhu isikhungo samemezela ukuthi ukusebenza ukude kwenyusa umkhiqizo. Kodwa inhlolovo yabuza kuphela ngokwaneliseka okuzihlolelwe futhi ayizange ilinganise ukusebenza kwangempela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ababambiqhaza ekusebenzeni ukude bagxile kakhulu emisebenzini enokuzimela okukhulu, ngakho kunzima ukwazi ukuthi umehluko wokwaneliseka uvela endleleni yokusebenza noma ebudlelwaneni bemisebenzi. Ngakho-ke le miphumela yodwa ayanele ukufinyelela esiphethweni sokuthi ukusebenza ukude kwenyusa umkhiqizo.
texts.g:9d18f689: Isilinganiso sezindleko zokuhlala kumholo emindenini yonke sisesilinganisweni samaphesenti angama-22, izinga elifanayo nelweminyaka emihlanu eyedlule. Abanye bakuthatha lokhu njengesizathu sokusho ukuthi umthwalo wezindlu awushintshanga. Kodwa-ke, isilinganiso semindeni engenamali encane kakhulu engama-20 ekhulwini sakhuphuka sisuka kuma-31 saya kuma-38 ekhulwini, kanti leso sama-20 ekhulwini aphezulu sehla sisuka kuma-15 saya kuma-12 ekhulwini. Ukukhuphuka ohlangothini olulodwa nokwehla kolunye kwaqedana, futhi isilinganiso saqhubeka nje sinjalo. Isilinganiso sisitshela umgogodla wesiyonke kodwa asibonisi izinguquko ezenzeka phakathi kwamaqembu. Ngakho-ke akumele umuntu agxume kusukela eqinisweni lokuthi isilinganiso siyafana aye esiphethweni sokuthi umthwalo wawo wonke amakhaya ufana.
texts.g:36c84153: Ngonyaka wawo wokuqala, umtapo wezincwadi osanda kuvulwa i-Hansol uthole izivakashi ezingu-40 peresenti ngaphezu konyaka odlule, futhi idolobha lanquma ukuthi isiko lokufunda labantu lisakazekile. Kodwa ngesikhathi esifanayo, izincwadi ezibolekiwe zakhula nge-3 peresenti kuphela. Ocwaningweni lwabasebenzisi, iningi lathi lize ukuzofunda egumbini lokufunda. Inani lezivakashi lingaba umkhombandlela ovezela ukufinyeleleka nokunethezeka kwesikhungo, kodwa alimelele ngqo inani lokufunda. Ukukhuluma ngokusakazeka kwesiko lokufunda, eminye imikhombandlela efana nenani lezincwadi ezibolekiwe noma isikhathi sokufunda kufanele ibonakaliswe ndawonye.
texts.g:877e9eb2: Ukwanda kwamanani abathengi kwalo nyaka kwakungu-2.1 peresenti ngokusemthethweni, kodwa izakhamuzi eziningi zizwa ukuthi izindleko zokuphila zikhuphuke kakhulu kunalokho. Ngalo mehluko, kuvela ukugxekwa kokuthi izibalo ziyaphendula iqiniso. Nokho, inkomba yamanani inani elibalwe ngokubeka izisindo zezinto ngokuya ngesakhiwo sokusebenzisa semuzi omaphakathi. Ngonyaka lapho amanani okudla ekhuphuka ngo-5 peresenti, izinga elizwakala yimindeni engenayo ephansi echitha okuningi ekudleni lizoba phezulu kunelijwayelekile. Ekugcineni, umehluko phakathi kwenombolo esemthethweni nalokho abantu abakuzwayo uvela hhayi ngoba ukubala kungalungile kodwa ngoba inombolo eyodwa ayikwazi ukumela yonke imindeni.
texts.g:70fd5ba4: Ukuthengiswa kwesiphuzo esisha kwenyuke nge-20 peresenti ezinyangeni ezintathu ngemva kokuqala kokukhangisa ngoJuni uma kuqhathaniswa nezinyanga ezintathu zangaphambilini. Iqembu lokumaketha limise leli grafu njengobufakazi bomphumela wokukhangisa. Nokho, lesi siphuzo ngumkhiqizo isidingo sawo siyakhula ehlobo, futhi ngisho nonyaka odlule, ngaphandle kokukhangisa, ukuthengisa kwenyuke nge-18 peresenti ngesikhathi esifanayo. Uma kubhekwa lokhu, ukwanda okuhlobene nokukhangisa kungaphezulu cishe ngamaphuzu angu-2 peresenti. Nokho, isimo sezulu nemikhiqizo ephikisanayo kungenzeka kwakwehlukile phakathi konyaka odlule nalo nyaka, ngakho ngisho nale nombolo kunzima ukuyithatha njengomphumela oqinisekisiwe.
texts.g:6a73ec88: Lapho isitolo se-inthanethi senza ucwaningo lokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende, abangu-35 peresenti babaphenduli bakhetha 'bangeneliseki kakhulu.' Abanye abaphathi bacabanga ukuthi kuvele inkinga enzima kusevisi. Kodwa izinga lokuphendula kwalolu cwaningo lalingu-12 peresenti kuphela, futhi amakhasimende anezikhalazo avame ukuphendula ucwaningo ngokuzimisela kakhulu. Ngakho-ke inombolo engu-35 peresenti ayikwazi ukufundwa njengesilinganiso sawo wonke amakhasimende. Lokho akusho ukuthi lolu data alunamsebenzi, nokho. Izizathu zokungeneliseki ababhale phansi abaphenduli zingaba yizinkomba zokuthi yimaphi amasimu okufanele athuthukiswe kuqala.
texts.g:70ffd4cd: Isilinganiso samaphuzu abafundi abagwema ukudla ibhulakufesi sasiphansi ngamaphuzu angu-6 kunabafundi abayidlayo. Umphumela lona uvame ukucashunwa njengesisekelo senkulumo ethi ukudla ibhulakufesi kuphakamisa impumelelo yezemfundo. Kodwa uma kuqhathaniswa kuphela abafundi emizini enemali engenayo efanayo, ukuhlukana kwamaphuzu kwancipha kwaba ngu-1.5. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi abafundi abavela emindenini engenayo ephansi bavame kakhulu ukugwema ibhulakufesi futhi kaningi nabo banezimo zokufunda ezingezinhle. Lolu hlaziyo alusho ukuthi ibhulakufesi ayinawo nakancane umphumela, kodwa lubonisa ngokucacile ukuthi ingxenye enkulu yokuhlukana okwabonwa ekuqaleni ichazwa ezinye izinto.
texts.g:844ee22d: Lapho isampula incane, iphutha emiphumeleni livame ukuba likhulu.
texts.g:d839f44d: Cishe ingxenye yabaphendulile bathe banikeza inani elikhulu ekhwalithi kunentengo.
texts.g:6fee16d1: Nakuba imali engenayo ikhuphukile, izinga lokonga lavela lehle esikhundleni salokho.
texts.n:k.k9.review_k9:revHon: Ukubuyekeza: -(으)시- kuhlonipha omunye umuntu, izenzo ezithobekile ze--드리- zichaza izenzo zakho kuye, kanti -(스)ㅂ니다 igcina ithoni isemthethweni.
texts.n:k.k9.review_k9:revVocab: Ukubuyekeza: amabizo esiSino-Korean ebhizinisi avame ukubukeka afana, ngakho khetha ngokwencazelo nangesenzo asihlanganisa naso.
texts.s:a122a17d: Umuntu ucela isikhathi somhlangano futhi udinga ukubheka ikhalenda lakho.
texts.s:0a04257f: Awuzange uqonde incazelo futhi uyayicela futhi ngenhlonipho.
texts.s:518a3c4f: Osebenza naye ukusizile ukuqeda umsebenzi wakho.
texts.s:041dba0a: Uthembisa ikhasimende ukuletha umbhalo ngasekupheleni kosuku.
texts.s:c90c163d: Umema ngenhlonipho isivakashi ukuthi siqale ukukhuluma emhlanganweni.
texts.g:3f33725f: Umbiko wohambo lwebhizinisi kumele ufakwe phakathi kweviki ngemva kokubuya.
texts.g:eb27f927: Ngizoqhubeka nalolu daba ngemva kokuthola imvume yomphathi wesigaba.
texts.g:d5e564ff: Nginomsebenzi omningi kuleli viki, ngakho ngicabanga ukuthi kuzodingeka ngisebenze isikhathi esengeziwe.
texts.g:81c8a6b9: Kuvele okuphuthumayo, ngakho ngicabanga ukuthi ngeke ngikwazi ukuhlala emhlanganweni.
texts.g:21439490: Ngizoxhumana nawe ngemva kokubika kumphathi wesigaba.
texts.g:7a1064f6: Ukuthengisa kwale nyanga yezinyanga ezintathu kudlule inhloso ngo-10 peresenti.
texts.g:270a0a19: Sicela uphinde uhlole imigomo ngaphambi kokusayina inkontileka.
texts.g:93802476: Umkhiqizo omusha wamukelwe kahle, ngakho ama-oda aphindeke kabili.
texts.g:c167797b:
A: Mphathi Wesibili, ungahlola uhlelo lohambo lwebhizinisi lwakusasa?
B: Yebo, uya eBusan ngendiza ngehora lesishiyagalolunye ekuseni.
A: Umhlangano nekhasimende ngasikhathi sini?
B: Ngehora lesibili ntambama, futhi ngikuthumelele izinto zomhlangano nge-imeyili.
texts.g:6a8b5faa:
KuMphathi Wesigaba uLee,
Ngicela imvume yakho.
Ngifake inkontileka nekhasimende elisha, ngakho sicela uyibuyekeze.
Ngingabonga uma ungaphendula namuhla.
texts.n:k.k10.culture_deep:habitual: Amasiko akhonjiswa ngezenzo zesikhathi samanje zalokho abantu abakwenza njalo, kaningi ngamabizo wesiko noma isiko.
texts.g:c0eaaee5: Umuntu one-nunchi esheshayo uzwa isimo somunye umuntu ngisho engatshelwanga.
texts.g:99095a49: AmaKorea abeka ukubaluleka okukhulu ekugcineni ubuso phambi kwabanye.
texts.g:fa697d7b: Ngosuku Lonyaka Omusha WeNyanga, abantu bakhothama kwabadala futhi bathole izipho zemali.
texts.g:29a6105a: Abantu bathi uthola unyaka ngobudala ngokudla isobho lekhekhe lelayisi ekuseni konyaka omusha.
texts.g:54990d5f: Ngesikhathi seChuseok, abantu bavakashela amathuna okhokho babo.
texts.g:e756c6e1: Kunesiko lokudla isobho lolwandle (i-miyeok) ekuseni kosuku lokuzalwa komuntu.
texts.g:eaacf306: Ngosuku lokuzalwa lokuqala lwengane, kuba nomcimbi futhi ingane ikhetha into etafuleni.
texts.g:bf6ebf5d: Ngaphambi kokuba kufike ubusika, omakhelwane bahlangana benza i-kimchi ndawonye.
texts.g:73b15dba: Uma uya emshadweni, kuyinhlonipho ukunikeza isipho semali sokubingelela.
texts.g:c87cda76: Uma uya emngcwabeni, abantu banikeza imali yosizo futhi bakhala ngokuthula.
texts.g:fb00f0a7: Ngemva kokuthuthela ekhaya elisha, abantu bamema abangani emcimbini wokufudukela.
texts.g:867b21b6: Abantu bakhumula izicathulo uma bengena endlini.
texts.g:79b030c5: Uma uphuza nomuntu omdala, kuyinhlonipho ukuphendulela ikhanda lakho lapho uphuza.
texts.g:587ded32: Uma unikeza okuthile kumuntu omdala, kusetshenziswa izandla zombili.
texts.g:16c17ab1: Ukubuza iminyaka yomuntu ongamazi kuyindlela yokunquma izihloko nesitayela sokukhuluma.
texts.g:2b01b8d4: ESiKorean, abantu bavame ukuthi 'yethu' ngisho nasezintweni ezifana nekhaya 'lami' noma unina 'wami'.
texts.g:b2e9b57e: I-Ondol uhlelo lwendabuko lokushisa olufudumeza phansi.
texts.g:9f8f16af: I-Hanbok igqokwa ezinsukwini ezikhethekile ezifana nezinsuku zeholide nemishado.
texts.g:65461830: Abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukudla iphalishi lamabhontshisi abomvu ngosuku lwe-winter solstice kuxosha inhlanhla embi.
texts.g:abde95a2: Ezinsukwini ezishisa kakhulu zehlobo, abantu badla isobho lenkukhu ne-ginseng ukuze babuyisele amandla.
texts.g:d7b6477c: Ngenyanga egcwele yokuqala yonyaka, abantu bahlephula amantongomane futhi bafisele unyaka onempilo.
texts.g:d002b1c5: Ngosuku lwesivivinyo sokungena enyuvesi, izikhathi zokuqala umsebenzi ziyaphindiselwa emuva futhi wonke umuntu uyabakhuthaza abahlolwayo.
texts.g:74455bff: EKorea, ebiyisibaluleka ukuhlonipha abazali, imizi eminingi yayiphila futhi inakekela abazali bayo.
texts.g:7b9ccd1a: I-Pumasi isiko lokusizana emsebenzini nokubuyisela umusa.
texts.g:bfb397ed: Ezinsukwini zeholide ezinkulu, imindeni iyahlangana futhi yenze imihlangano yokukhumbula okhokho.
texts.g:0476afea: Ngosuku lwe-Hangul, abantu bakhumbula ukudalwa kwealfabhethi yesiKorea nguKing Sejong.
texts.g:20538219: Ku-jjimjilbang, abantu bayabila izithukuthuku futhi bachitha isikhathi nomndeni nabangane.
texts.g:fa5bf7ca: Ekudleni, uqala ukudla ngemva kokuba omdala kunabo bonke ethathe isipunu namachopsticks akhe.
texts.g:9512d04e: EKorea, isiko le-'jeong' lokwabelana ngokudla nomakhelwane selihlale isikhathi eside.
texts.g:09d4434e: Kunokuhlaziya ukuthi isiko lakwaKorea le-'ppalli-ppalli' lahlanganisa impande ngesikhathi sokukhula okusheshayo kwezomnotho.
texts.g:4a7216bf: Ukusebenzisa inkulumo ehloniphekile nengajwayelekile ngokuhlukile kuyisimo solimi esembula ubudlelwano bakho nomunye umuntu.
texts.g:dbdd19d8: EKorea, abantu bavame ukubizwa ngesihloko somsebenzi noma ngobudlelwano obunjengokuthi 'unina ka-fulana' esikhundleni segama.
texts.g:203bdce4: Ukwenqaba ukudla othile akunikeza kanye noma kabili kungavela ngezinye izikhathi ekufiseni ukuhlonipha.
texts.g:74724f36: Isiko leholide laseKorea liyashintsha kancane kancane. Ngaphambili, umndeni nezihlobo zazihlangana endlini eyodwa futhi zichitha izinsuku zilungisa ukudla futhi zenza imihlangano yokukhumbula okhokho. Nokho, namuhla, imizi eminingi ilungisa amatafula alula noma iyahamba uhambo. Nakuba ifomu lishintsha, incazelo yokuchitha isikhathi ndawonye nokubheka omunye komunye isabhekwa njengebalulekile.
texts.g:4e23238d: Ifa lamasiko elingabonakali lisho ulwazi namakhono amalungu omphakathi adlulisele kuzizukulwane.
texts.g:fe5e1e70: Nakuba ifomu lalo lishintsha ngezikhathi, isiko lendabuko ligcina umsebenzi walo wokuqinisekisa izibopho zomphakathi.
texts.g:fae4710a: Amaculo omdabu adluliselwe esifundeni ngasinye abonisa ukuphila nemizwa yezakhamuzi zalo.
texts.g:0942f6e7: Ukunciphisa ukungaqondani phakathi kwamasiko, sidinga isimo sengqondo sokungahluleli elinye isiko ngezinga lethu.
texts.g:7486b8d2: Ukuhlonipha ubunjalo bamasiko babantu abafudukele kwelinye izwe kuxoxwa ngakho njengesimo sokuqala sokuhlanganiswa komphakathi.
texts.g:afc76388: Namuhla sizobheka ukulondolozwa kwe-hanok ngokombono wenqubomgomo yefa lamasiko. I-hanok akuyona nje indawo yokuhlala kodwa ingumkhiqizo wamasiko lapho isimo sezulu nendlela yokuphila kuhlanganiswe khona. Kodwa-ke, uma umuntu ayilungisa kabusha ukuze ihambisane nobulula besimanje, isakhiwo sayo esihlukile singalimala. Ngalokhu, ukulingana phakathi kokulondoloza nokusebenzisa kuyindaba eyinhloko.
texts.g:5eec1ae4: A: Kunokugxekwa kokuthi imikhosi yasendaweni iya ngokuya ibe yibhizinisi kakhulu. B: Ngenxa yokuthi inani lezivakashi lisetshenziswa njengenkomba yokusebenza, izindaba zasendaweni ezizodwa kuleyo ndawo zibe buthaka ngezindlela ezithile. C: Ngibona ngokwehlukile. Izakhamuzi zingaqhubeka nomkhosi kuphela uma kunemali engenayo, ngakho kunzima ukuphikisa ibhizinisi uqobo lwalo. Okubalulekile ukwakha isakhiwo lapho imali engenayo ibuyela emphakathini wendawo.
texts.g:83f2d8a3: Isisekelo simemezela imiphumela yokukhethwa kohlelo lwaso lokusekela ukulondolozwa kwezandla zendabuko ngokulandelayo. Kulo nyaka amaqembu ayisikhombisa kwangamashumi amathathu afake izicelo akhethwa, futhi ukuhlola kugxile ekwenzekeni kokudlulisela amakhono nokuxhumana nomphakathi wendawo. Amaqembu angakhethiwe azonikezwa amazwana okuhlola ngokubhaliwe.
texts.g:acba7a7b: A: Kunokukhathazeka okukhulu ngokuthi izilimi zesifunda ziyanyamalala. Ucabanga ukuthi yini imbangela? B: Kungenxa yokuthi ulimi olusemthethweni luhlakazeke kakhulu ngokusakaza nemfundo, nokuthi intsha ukuthuthela emadolobheni kunciphise amathuba okusebenzisa ulimi lwesifunda. A: Kufanele kwenziwe ini ukulondoloza izilimi zesifunda? B: Kunokumane ziqoshwe nje, kufanele zixhunywe nemfundo yendawo ukuze zisetshenziswe ngempela empilweni yansuku zonke.
texts.g:001b4b52: Isihloko sesifundo sanamuhla yindlela yokuphatha umongo wamasiko ekuhumusheni. Ukuhumusha igama negama kunenzuzo yokwethembeka kokuqala, kodwa kungashiya izincazelo ezizwakala zingajwayelekile kubafundi. Ngokuphambene, ukuhumusha okukhululekile kulula ukukufunda, kodwa kunengozi yokuthi isimilo sokuqala sisuswe. Sizoqhathanisa amandla nobuthakathaka bezindlela ezimbili ngezibonelo.
texts.g:fedf0417: A: Kunempikiswano eningi ngesiko lokubuza iminyaka kuqala lapho abantu behlangana. Ubona kanjani? B: Njengoba isiKorean sishintsha izindlela zokubiza nesitayela sokukhuluma kuye ngomunye umuntu, ngibona ukubuza iminyaka njengenqubo esebenzayo yokumisa uhlaka lwengxoxo. C: Ngiyayamukela leyo nqubo, kodwa ingabe ayiphumeli esakhiweni lapho uhlangothi oluphezulu ngeminyaka lulawula ingxoxo lube yingxenye eqinile? B: Angiphiki ukuthi kukhona umphumela onjalo. Kodwa lokho kuyimiphumela eyadalwa yisiko, hhayi isizathu sokuba khona kwalo. Uma uhlelo lokubizana lushintsha, umbuzo nawo uzokwehla ngokwemvelo.
texts.g:fcb8250f: A: Singachaza kanjani isiko lokushintshanisa izipho zomkhosi ngisho nokuqinisekisa ukuzibuyisela? B: Ngikubona njengophawu lokwethembana isikhathi eside. Isifiso sokubuyisela lokho okwamukelwe siba ucingo olugcina ubudlelwano buqhubeka. C: Kodwa uma abantu bezama ukubuyisela ngqo lokho abakwamukele, ingabe empeleni akuhlukile ekuthengiseni? B: Ngaphezulu kungabukeka kanjalo. Kodwa uma bekungukuthengiselana, ubudlelwano bebuzophela ngesikhathi kukhokhwa intengo. Ukwengeza kancane ngamabomu esipheni sokubuyisa ukuze kusale isikweletu kusho ukuthi umuntu akahlosile ukuqeda ubudlelwano. Angiphiki ukuthi ukubala kukhona. Kuyinto nje ukuthi inhloso yalokho kubala ukuqhubeka, hhayi ukuvala ama-akhawunti.
texts.g:46ef3493: A: Abanye bagxeka i-hanbok yansuku zonke, elungiswe ukuze igqokwe empilweni yansuku zonke, ngokuthi yonakalisa isiko. C: Ngicabanga ukuthi uma isakhiwo, njengesilinganiso sejekethi nesiketi nokusetshenziswa kwezibopho zeribhoni, singagcinwa, kunzima ukukubiza ngokuthi yi-hanbok. B: Ngiyavuma ukuthi isakhiwo esiyisisekelo kufanele sihlonishwe. Kodwa uma siphikelela ngendlela endala ngisho nasempahleni, ubude, nendlela yokubopha, kungase kungabi khona osele ogqokayo. C: Usho ukuthi uma kungekho ogqokayo, isiko liyanqunywa. B: Yebo. Okugqokwayo okubekwe emnyuziyamu nokugqokwa abantu kugcinwa ngezindlela ezihlukene. Ngicabanga ukuthi lokho kokugcina kuhlala isikhathi eside.
texts.g:8a212118: A: Imizi ephila nabazali iyancipha; ingabe ukuqonda ukuhlonipha abazali kuyaphela? B: Ngicabanga ukuthi akuphelanga kangako kunokuba kushintshe indlela yokuvezwa. Ngisho noma abantu bengahlali ndawonye, ukuhlonipha abazali kuyaqhubeka ngokwabelana ngemali yesibhedlela nokugcina ukuxhumana njalo. C: Leyo ncazelo icabanga ukuthi umndeni uyaqhubeka nokubhekela ukunakekelwa. Akuyona yini leyo ngqikithi eyinkinga? B: Umbuzo uqobo uyavumeleka. Kodwa kuze kube yilapho uhlelo luhlinzeka ngokwesekwa okwanele, leyo ngqikithi ayikwazi ukukhishwa ngobusuku obubodwa. Kuphela ngemva kokuba uhlelo selukhona singakhuluma ngokuhlonipha abazali njengokukhetha hhayi isibopho.
texts.g:7a77c58f: A: Inani lemizi ezenzela i-kimchi liyehla. Ingabe isiko lokwenza i-kimchi liyanyamalala? B: Kunzima ukuhlulela ngenani lemizi eyenza yodwa. Ngisho noma abantu bethenga, uma umkhuba wokwabelana nomakhelwane nokubuza ngabo ugcinwa, isiko liyaqhubeka. C: Kodwa uma inqubo yokuhlangana ukusebenza ndawonye inyamalala, ukwabelana lokho nakho ngeke kuhlale isikhathi eside? B: Lokho kukhathazeka kunenzuzo. Yingakho isikhungo sethu sibeka umzamo ekurekhodeni nasekusekeleni umkhuba wokuhlangana nokwabelana, kunokunambitheka kwe-kimchi.
texts.g:bc4d2c30: A: Bathi ukuphindisela emuva izikhathi zokuqala umsebenzi nokulungisa nokukhuphuka nokufika kwezindiza ngosuku lwesivivinyo kubukeka kuyinqaba kubantu bakwamanye amazwe. B: Ngiyiqonda njengesithembiso somphakathi sokuvikela ukulingana kwesivivinyo. Kungumzamo wokuvumela wonke umuntu abhale isivivinyo ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo. C: Akwandisi yini lokho kucabangela, ngakolunye uhlangothi, umthwalo abahlolwayo abawuzwayo? B: Kungase. Kodwa uma sisusa ukucabangela, ukungalingani kwezimo kuzovela. Ngicabanga ukuthi ukunciphisa umthwalo kumele kuqale hhayi ekulungiseni isikali sokucabangela kodwa ekulungiseni isakhiwo okunethuba elilodwa kuphela lokubhala isivivinyo.
texts.g:8889d001: A: Kwezinye izifunda, kudalwe uhlelo lapho abantu bashintshisana ngomsebenzi, kubalwe ngamahora. Ingabe lingabizwa ngokuthi uhlobo lwanamuhla lwe-pumasi? B: Ngicabanga ukuthi lungenisa umoya walo. Lufana ngokuthi umzamo ubuyiselwa ngobudlelwano hhayi ngemali. C: Kodwa njengoba isikali sikhula, akukhuphuki yini izindleko zokuqopha nokuphatha amahora futhi kwehle ukusebenza kahle? B: Leso yisikhombisi esihle. Ngakho ngicabanga ukuthi uhlelo olunjalo lusebenza kangcono emzaneni omncane lapho abantu bazana, futhi ukulwandisa lufike edolobheni lonke akunangqondo. Kodwa-ke, ngifuna ukwengeza ukuthi inani lalolu hlelo lisebudlelwaneni, hhayi ekusebenzeni kahle.
texts.n:k.k10.idioms_action:figurativeB: Izisho ziyafundwa njengezinto eziphelele ngendlela ejwayelekile yesichazamazwi; incazelo yazo ngokomfanekiso ayikwazi ukucatshangwa ngamagama aqondile.
texts.n:k.k10.idioms_action:noun: Ezinye izisho ziyimishwana yamabizo noma yezandiso kunezenzo, futhi zinamathela emushweni njenganoma yisiphi esinye isichasisi.
texts.n:k.k10.idioms_action:id: Isisho sengxenye yomzimba yinto emiswe isenzo esishintsha njengesenzo esijwayelekile; incazelo yaso ngokomfanekiso ikhonjiswa isimo esichazwe kwesinye isahluko somusho.

texts.g:22712060: ukwenzela wonke umuntu ukudla noma iziphuzo
texts.g:81a715a9: ukuba nesihle ngenani, ukunikela noma ukupheka kakhulu
texts.g:fae74777: ukuba nezindinganiso eziphakeme nokuba nzima ukwaneliseka

texts.g:beb2e810: Ukwethula kungakusasa futhi angikaqedi ngisho ingxenye yezinto, ngakho ngimatasa impela ngesikhathi.
texts.g:65796e7b: Ama-odha afike ngesikhathi esisodwa ekupheleni konyaka, ngakho kulezi zinsuku ngipakisha ngaphandle kwesikhashana.
texts.g:95f9da6d: Umngane wami wazi ukugcina imfihlo, ngakho akayiphindanga kunoma ubani inkathazo engimtshele yona.
texts.g:a637ac09: Inhloko yesigaba inabantu abaningi ebaziyo embonini, ngakho kunoma iyiphi inkampani okungenani kunomuntu oyedwa ayaziyo.
texts.g:282997a3: Njengoba senziwe umholi weqembu futhi nginesibopho semiphumela yamalungu ayishumi, kuyinto evamile ukuzwa isisindo sesibopho.
texts.g:b28c79ea: Lapho ingane, eyayilahlekile, ibuya ngemva kwemizuzu eyishumi, abazali baphefumula ngokuphumula.
texts.g:ec0632e9: Ngabamba inkinga yezibalo ihora lonke, kodwa njengoba ngingakwazanga ukuyixazulula nhlobo, ekugcineni ngayeka.
texts.g:b74d6f4a: Isikhalo abasebenzi abasizwa kaningi emihlanganweni ukuthi imibono yabo ayibonakali noma bekhulume. Uma abanamandla okunquma bengalaleli ngokucophelela abasebenzi, abantu kancane kancane bavala imilomo yabo. Khona-ke izinkinga endaweni zibuthana ngokungabonakali futhi zibuya kamuva ngezindleko ezinkulu. Umholi omuhle, ngaphambi kokuba abe umuntu owenelisa abanye ngemibono yakhe, ungumuntu owazi ukulalela abanye kuze kube sekugcineni.
texts.n:k.k10.idioms_body:figurative: Lezi zisho ziyizinkulumo ezimiswe: ingxenye yomzimba isetshenziswa ngokomfanekiso, ngakho incazelo ayisona isamba samagama aqondile.
texts.n:k.k10.idioms_body:pairs: Ezinye izisho ziza ngamabili aphikisanayo (umlomo osinda noma ophansi), futhi ilungu ngalinye lebili linencazelo yalo ehlukile.

texts.g:334b74db: ukungabi namahloni futhi ube nesikhumba esinzima
texts.g:b5c041bc: ukuhlala emcabangweni futhi kube nzima ukukhohlwa
texts.g:e78d528c: ukuzizwa inhliziyo yakho ishona ngenxa yokushaqeka okungazelelwe
texts.g:8c152d7b: Lapho umlilo omkhulu uqubuka emzaneni, omakhelwane basheshe bamisa ukusiza ngokuzimisela.
texts.g:49d952c7: Njalo ngezikhathi zamaholidi esikole, ugogo ulindela ngokungabekezeli ukuthi abazukulu bakhe beze.
texts.g:43619a43: Lapho bezwa intengo yekhonsoli yemidlalo emisha, bonke abangane bami basala bevulekile imilomo bemangele.
texts.g:d972df0b: Isivivinyo sisondele, ngakho kulezi zinsuku ngifunda kuze kube sebusuku kakhulu.
texts.g:2cd8bd2f: Ngemva kokunqoba umjaho, lowo mdlali weza wema eceleni kwabadlali abangcono emhlabeni.
texts.g:76873424: Isi-Korean sinezinkulumo eziningi zesiqhulo ezisebenzisa izingxenye zomzimba. Isibonelo, inkulumo ethi 'izindlebe ezincane' ayisho ngokoqobo ukuthi izindlebe zincane, kodwa isho ukuthi umuntu ushukumiswa kalula yilokho okushiwo ngabanye. Ukuchaza izinkulumo ezinjalo igama negama kwenza kube lula ukungaqondi kahle. Ngakho izisho kufanele zifundwe kanye nezimo ezisetshenziswa kuzo.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:connector: Amabizo abophekile nezifinyezo ezifana no-(으)ㄴ 만큼 zisho isizathu noma izinga futhi zijwayelekile ekucabangeni okusemthethweni emibikweni.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:concession: Izimpawu zokuvuma nezimo ezifana no-'although', 'if', no-'however much' zidinga izifinyezo ezifanayo ngokuhamba komusho.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:nominalise: Imibiko ebhaliwe iguqula izigaba zibe yimishwana yamabizo ngezifinyezo ze--ㅁ/-기 bese inamathisela amapharamitha entweni, esiqu noma esenzi kuzo.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:academicHedge: Ukubhala kwezemfundo kuthambisa izimangalo ngamaphethini amisiwe afana no-'could', 'may', no-'it is hard to assert' esikhundleni sokusho ukuqiniseka.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:academicConn: Impikiswano ebhaliwe esemthethweni isebenzisa izinkulumo ezimisiwe zokuxhumanisa nokuvuma ezinezifinyezo okumele zifane nesigaba ezixhuma kuso.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:causeLink: Abaxhumanisi abafana no-이에 따라 no-결과적으로 baxhumanisa umphumela nesizathu esisanda kushiwo, ngakho isigaba sangaphambilini kumele sinikeze leso sizathu.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:hedge: Izifinyezo ezithambile ezifana no--(으)ㄹ 것으로 보이다 no--기 어렵다 zigcina isimangalo esibhaliwe esisemthethweni singaqinisekile esikhundleni sokusisho ngokuphelele.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:nominal: Imishwana yamabizo eguqulwe ibe yibizo ephela nge--(으)ㄴ/는 + ibizo, -다는/-리라는 + ibizo, noma -에 대한 + ibizo icindezela isigaba sonke ukuze sisebenze njengesiqu somusho osemthethweni.
texts.g:44e2190b: Le ndawo yokudlela inokudla okumnandi futhi, ngaphezu kwalokho, amanani ashibhile.
texts.g:4d0bd34d: Ukuthunyelwa kwempahla phesheya kukhule kakhulu futhi, ngenxa yalokho, nemisebenzi iye yanda.
texts.g:80d7acbe: Naphezu kwesikhathi esifushane sokulungiselela, imiphumela yayinhle kakhulu.
texts.g:aea873d1: Imifino, isibonelo isipinashi noma i-broccoli, ilungele impilo yakho.
texts.g:414ff210: Ungumalumeni wami, kungaleyo ndlela, ungumfowabo omncane kamama.
texts.g:05a2a1ae: Ngemva kokuhlupheka kaningi, ekugcineni nganquma ukushintsha inkampani.
texts.g:d9ec48ac: Yebo akulula, kodwa ngiyafuna ngempela ukukuqeda.
texts.g:746daf9e: Phakathi kokudla kwaseKorea, ngithanda kakhulu isobho le-kimchi.
texts.g:922691f7: Uyasebenza ngezimpelasonto futhi ngisho nasezinsukwini zeholide.
texts.g:00857f0f: Umfowethu omkhulu uvuka ekuseni, futhi ngokufanayo nomfowethu omncane uvuka ekuseni.
texts.g:9720cc00: Empeleni, nami ngiwuzwe okokuqala namhlanje lowo mbiko.
texts.g:ecf4d080: Kufanele uzivocavoce okungenani imizuzu engamashumi amathathu ngosuku.
texts.g:9e5ff818: Amadolobha anemisebenzi eminingi, kodwa izindlu zibiza kakhulu.
texts.g:4563d114: Uma kuqhathaniswa nonyaka odlule, kuneqhwa eliningi kulo nyaka.
texts.g:0b5fd392: Nakuba kunzima, ngizozama kuze kube sekugcineni.
texts.g:50a0a74d: Noma ngabe uhlala uphithizela kangakanani, kufanele ushayele umndeni wakho ukuze uzwe ukuthi unjani.
texts.g:ed113e60: Okokuqala, isikhathi besifushane, futhi okwesibili, nesabelomali besingenele.
texts.g:a1e9153a: Ngiphikisana nalolu hlelo ngoba izindleko ziphakeme kakhulu.
texts.g:2cad8f36: Ngale ndlela, izenzo ezincane ziyahlangana zidale ushintsho olukhulu.
texts.g:c17a541b: Ukunambitheka kuhle; into nje ukuthi isabelo sincane kancane.
texts.g:999cac19: Inqubo yayinzima, kodwa noma kunjalo, ngiyajabula ngoba umphumela muhle.
texts.g:4f42e960: Ngokufunda kakhulu, ngiqonda kakhulu ukuthi angazi.
texts.g:046f2413: Kafushane, umongo walenqubomgomo akukona ukunciphisa izindleko kodwa ukuqinisa ukuphepha.
texts.g:17795eb1: Isimangalo sokuthi indlela iyasebenza siphelelwa ukuqinisekisa uma kungekho bufakazi obanele.
texts.g:48d09f1b: Ngoba le nkinga inzima ukuyixazulula ngomzamo womuntu ngamunye kuphela, kudingeka ukwesekwa ngokwezikhungo.
texts.g:d0f04f2b: Hlonipha ukhetho lwabathengi, kodwa nesibopho samabhizinisi kufanele sibizwe ngokucacile.
texts.g:f075b727: Abanye abantu bayaphikelela ukuthi zonke izifundo zesikole kufanele zidluliselwe ku-inthanethi. Yebo, izifundo ze-inthanethi zinenzuzo yokunciphisa imikhawulo yesikhathi nendawo. Kodwa-ke, ulwazi lokuxoxisana nokubambisana nabangane lunzima ukulutholela ezifundweni zesikrini kuphela. Ngakho, izifundo ze-inthanethi kufanele zisetshenziswe ukwengeza kunokuba zithathe isikhundla sezifundo ezibhekene ubuso nobuso.
texts.g:1788bcc5: Njengoba abahumushi be-AI beqala ukusetshenziswa kabanzi, umbono wokuthi ukufunda izilimi zakwamanye amazwe akusadingeki uyakhula. Kodwa-ke, abahumushi bavame ukushiya inhloso ebucayi ephethwe umongo noma ithoni. Ukwahlulela ukuthi inguqulo ilungile yini, umsebenzisi ekugcineni kumele aqonde lolo limi. Kafushane, umhumushi uyithuluzi elisiza ekufundeni izilimi zakwamanye amazwe, hhayi elizithatha indawo.
texts.g:a246688e: Kuvame ukuthiwa ukuncintisana kuyimbangela eqhubekayo yentuthuko. Ngempela ukuncintisana kukhipha umzamo. Kodwa uma ukuncintisana kweqile, abantu bafihlana ulwazi ngisho nalapho ukubambisana kudingeka, futhi ukusebenza okuphelele kuyehla. Uma kunjalo, inkinga akukona ukuthi ukuncintisana kukhona yini kodwa izinga lawo nefomu lawo. Ekugcineni, esikufanele sibuze akukona ukuthi sikuqede yini ukuncintisana kodwa ukuthi sidizayine uhlobo luni lokuncintisana.
texts.g:99463034: A: Ngivumelana nokwandiswa komsebenzi wekude. Unciphisa isikhathi sokuhamba, okukhuphula izinga lokuphila kwabasebenzi. B: Ngiyalivuma ithuba olisho. Kodwa ucwaningo olungubufakazi bakho lwabandakanya abasebenzi basehhovisi kuphela. Kunzima ukusho ukuthi isiphetho esifanayo siyasebenza ngisho namaqembu emisebenzi adinga ukuba khona endaweni. A: Kunjalo. Yingakho ngiphakamisa ukuthi sihlukanise ububanzi bokwethulwa ngeqembu lomsebenzi.
texts.g:4a61030a: Abanye abantu bakhathazeka ngokuthi imfundo yesiNgisi yasekuqaleni ivimbela ukukhula kolimi lwebele. Kodwa lokhu kukhathazeka kusekelwe ephuzwini lokuthi amathuba ingane okuhlangana nolimi lwebele anciphiswa yilimi lwamanye amazwe. Empeleni, izifundo ezingeke zibe nalutho zikhombisa ukuthi ezinganeni ezisebenzisa ulimi lwebele kakhulu ekhaya, ukuvezwa kulimi lwamanye amazwe akulimazi amakhono olimi lwebele. Inkinga akukhona ukuthi ulimi lwamanye amazwe lufundwa ekuqaleni yini kodwa ukuthi isimo solimi lwebele sigcinwa kahle kangakanani. Uma ipuzu liguquka, isiphetho kufanele siguquke naso.
texts.g:6001b679: Lo mbiko ubheka ukuthi uhlelo lokwabela isabelomali lokubamba iqhaza kwabantu lukhuphule ukwambuleka kwezezimali. Kodwa ubufakazi obuphela nje ucwaningo lokwaneliseka kwabantu ababambe iqhaza. Ukwaneliseka okuphezulu akusho ngempela ukuthi izezimali sezambuleka. Uma izinkomba eziyisihloko njengezinga lokwambulwa kokusetshenziswa kwesabelomali noma inani lemiphumela yokuhlola zibekwe nazo, ukwethembeka esiphethweni bekuyoba phezulu kakhulu. Ekugcineni, isiphetho somsebenzi sihambe kakhulu phambi kobufakazi baso.
texts.g:5083f824: Abanye bathi ukuvimbela izimpompi zokuphuza zepulasitiki kuzoba nomthelela omncane ngoba izimpompi zakha ingxenye encane yawo wonke udoti wepulasitiki. Uma ubheka izibalo kuphela, lokho akukona okungalungile. Kodwa ukwakha inhloso yomthetho wezimpompi zokuphuza ngokususelwa kuphela ezingeni ledoti elehlisiwe kuwukuhumusha okuncane. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi umthetho uyisiqalo esiyisimboli esibuza ngemikhuba yokusebenzisa okwakuthatha izinto zokulahlwa njengezijwayelekile. Ngakho, uma kuhlolwa umphumela wawo, kufanele sicabangele izinguquko ekuqapheleni kanye nobuningi.
texts.g:f657e674: Emhlanganweni usihlalo wathi lolu daba lufanele ukubuyekezwa. Kodwa ngokushesha usihlalo wengeza ukuthi, njengoba uhlelo lwesabelomali selumisiwe, isinqumo kulo nyaka bekuzoba nzima. Amalungu ekomiti ayekhona athatha lokhu njengesibonakaliso sokuthi ukwethulwa kulo nyaka bekunzima ngempela. Nakuba ukuhlolwa okuhle kwafika kuqala, isimo esinamathiselwe ngemva kwaso sikhombise isiqondiso sangempela. Elinye ilungu lathi amazwi bekumnene kodwa okuqukethwe bekucacile.
texts.g:9b42270e: Ukukhathazeka ngokuthi ubuchwepheshe bususa imisebenzi akusilutho olusha. Ukukhathazeka okufanayo kwakukhona lapho kuvela isihambisi sokuluka esinamandla. Kodwa uma ubheka emuva emlandweni, ubuchwepheshe bususe amanye amakhono kodwa futhi bakha imisebenzi ebingakaze ibe khona. Kusenesikhathi sokuthembela kulokhu. Izinguquko zesikhathi esidlule zenzeka ngezinkathi zeminyaka eminingi, kanti inguquko yamanje ishesha kakhulu. Uma kungekho sikhathi esanele sokujwayela, iqiniso nje lokuthi kuvela imisebenzi emisha alikwazi ukuthulisa ukukhathazeka komuntu ngamunye.
texts.g:a28eef03: Ochwepheshe bavame ukuqhathanisa ukuminyana kwezimoto emadolobheni nesimo semithambo yegazi evaliwe. Ukuphinda ukuhlinzwa okubanzisa imithambo evaliwe akwenzi ukuthi impilo ibe ngcono emsukeni. Njengoba nje kufanele kushintshwe imikhuba yokuphila, inqubomgomo echitha isabelomali ekubanzeni imigwaqo kuphela yehlisa ukuminyana okwesikhashana kuphela, futhi maduze izimoto ziyanda futhi. Lokhu isifaniso esizama ukukusho ukuthi kudingeka indlela eshintsha ezokuthutha zomphakathi nesakhiwo sedolobha ndawonye.
texts.g:90cd814c: Uma lo mcabango ulungile, umehluko ocacile kufanele uvele phakathi kweqembu lokuhlola neqembu lokulawula.
texts.g:4a38f548: Ngamanye amazwi, inhloso yalolu hlelo ukwandisa ukulingana.
texts.g:ef1c1108: Noma izindleko zikhuphuka, okungenani izinga lokuphepha alikwazi ukuthotshiswa.
texts.g:f0be3432: Iphuzu eliphikisanayo engxoxweni lisekutheni umthwalo womuntu ngamunye ungabekwa kuze kube kuphi.
texts.g:6338b839: Lokhu kuhumusha kuyavumeleka ngokwengxenye, kodwa kunzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kusebenza kuzo zonke izimo.
texts.g:22d5e131: Umphikisi uvume ukuthi uhlelo luyadingeka kodwa waveza ukungavumelani mayelana nokuthi lwethulwe nini.
texts.g:04cb0ebb: Uma konke kubhekwa ndawonye, imbangela yenkinga ingathiwa iyinkimbinkimbi kunokuba ibe eyodwa.
texts.g:d4d21d04: Ekuqaleni kwakukhona ukuphikiswa okuningi, kodwa ukwesekwa kwakhula kancane kancane njengoba kwadlula emihlanganweni yokuchazelwa.
texts.g:9ea85513: Nakuba izinzuzo zohlelo zicacile, imiphumela emibi yokuluqalisa akumele ishaywe indiva.
texts.g:a10ccf56: Isidingo sehle kakhulu futhi, ngenxa yalokho, izinkampani zaqala ukulungisa inani lemikhiqizo yazo.
texts.g:9e169fd9: Uhlangothi olusekelayo lugcizelele ukudalwa kwemisebenzi, kanti uhlangothi olumelene lukhathazeke ngomonakalo wemvelo.
texts.g:88a73aae: Ngenxa yokuthi isampula lalincane kakhulu, ukwethembeka kocwaningo kwabalwa kuphansi ngenxa yalokho.
texts.g:b95d8b5f: Engxoxweni yokuphikisana, ngaphambi kokuphikisa isimangalo somphikisi, kufanele uqale uqinisekise isisekelo saso ngokunembile.
texts.g:3723272c: Ukuthi izizathu zanele akusho ukuthi isiphetho silungile ngempela.
texts.g:ef9867a4: Inzuzo enkulu yokusebenza ukude ukuthi kunciphisa isikhathi sokuhamba uya emsebenzini, ngoba isikhathi esasisetshenziswa ekuhambeni singasetshenziselwa ukuphumula nokuzithuthukisa. Kodwa-ke, kunzima ukuphika umkhawulo wokuthi ukubambisana phakathi kwamalungu kuba nzima. Ngakho-ke, kunokusebenzisa indlela efanayo emsebenzini wonke, kungcono ukuhlanganisa ngokuvumelana nezimo ihhovisi nomsebenzi wasekhaya ngokuya ngohlobo lomsebenzi.
texts.g:ed4061c8: Kuhlolovo olulodwa, abafundi abeqa ukudla kwasekuseni babonise amamaki aphansi ngokwesilinganiso. Ngokusekelwe kulokhu, kwaphakanyiswa umbono wokwenza ukudla kwasekuseni kube ngokuphoqelekile. Kodwa-ke, iningi labafundi abeqa ukudla kwasekuseni bebelele kancane ngoba babehamba izikole zokufundisa ngokwengeziwe kuze kube sebusuku. Ukuze kuhlelwe ukuthi iyiphi into ethinta amamaki, kudingeka ukuqhathaniswa nesikhathi sokulala kugcinwe ezimeni ezifanayo. Inhlolovo yenziwa kubafundi abangamakhulu amabili ezikoleni ezintathu eziphakathi.
texts.g:340f7372: Idolobha lizindla ngokuvala echibini lokubhukuda likamasipala. Iqiniso lokuthi izindleko zokusebenza komsebenzisi ngamunye ziphindwe kabili kunalezo zesikhungo sangasese esiseduze lethulwe njengesizathu esiyinhloko. Kodwa leli nani lifaka ukusetshenziswa mahhala kwabantu asebekhulile nezingane, futhi izindleko zezokwelapha ezehliswe ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo yabasebenzisi azifakiwe kukhompyutha. Ukuthi ubani owabeka isisekelo sokuqhathanisa, nangenqubo ekuyiphi, akwenziwanga lisesidlangalaleni. Idolobha likhomba ukubeka inqubomgomo yalo yokugcina masinyane ngenyanga ezayo. Iqembu labasebenzisi seliqalile umkhankaso wokusayina ophikisana nokuvalwa.
texts.g:798f379b: Impikiswano yokuthi ukwelashwa kude kufanele kuvunyelwe ngokuphelele ithola ukukholisa okukhethekile ezifundeni lapho izikhungo zezokwelapha zimbalwa. Kodwa-ke, impikiswano ephikisayo yokuthi, ezigulini ezivakashe okokuqala, ukwenzeka kokuhlolwa ngephutha kunzima ukukucisha ngaphandle kokuhlolwa ngqo akukwazi ukuthathwa kalula nakho. Ekugcineni, indaba ephikisanayo ibonakala ingalele kakhulu ekuvumeleni noma ekuvimbeleni kunokuthi yiluphi ukwelashwa okufanele kuvunyelwe ngaphansi kweziphi izimo. Lendaba ihlelelwe ukuphathwa njengendaba eyinhloko enkundleni yokuthuthukisa uhlelo lwezokwelapha ezoba khona ngaphakathi kwalo nyaka.
texts.g:ef70cb2f: Isisho esiqhathanisa umlando nesibuko siyajwayeleka. Kodwa isibuko sibonisa kuphela lokho okume phambi kwaso, futhi asizinqumeli ukuthi sibonise kuphi futhi sihlibe kuphi. Enqubweni yokulandiswa komlando, kwenziwa kuqala ukukhetha ukuthi yini ezoqoshwa nokuthi yini ezoshiywa. Isehlakalo esifanayo sigcina siyisigcawu esihluke ngokuphelele kuye ngokuthi ubani oyibhalayo nasesikhathini sini. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi indlela imithombo ekhethwa futhi ihlelwa ngayo ngokwayo iyindawo yokuqala yokuhumusha. Okushiywa yisifaniso sesibuko isandla salowo obonisayo.
texts.g:245fcc4b: Kunocwaningo oluningi olubonisa ukuthi ukuqinisa imikhawulo yejubane kunciphisa ukufa emgwaqweni. Kodwa-ke, iningi laloku kucwaninga lagxila ezigabeni lapho kwafakwa nezinkamera zokuphoqelela. Ukuthi umphumela ofanayo uzovela yini ezindaweni ezingenakho ukuphoqelela akukakaqinisekiswa. Ukukhathazeka kokuthi umthetho oshintsha nje inombolo yomkhawulo wejubane ungase ungabi nemiphumela elindelekile kuvela lapha. Lombuzo uphakanyiswe ngokuphindaphindiwe ezifundeni ezinezimo zemigwaqo ezihlukene. Inkulumo ngomthethosivivinywa ohlobene okwamanje imisiwe.
texts.g:2b820a90: A: Kunombiko wokuthi isikhathi sokulala esimaphakathi sanda ngemva kokuqaliswa kwalo mthetho ezweni elivimbele ngokomthetho ukufinyelela emidlalweni yasebusuku yintsha. B: Lowombiko walandelela unyaka owodwa kuphela ngemva komthetho, wawulinganiselwe kubafundi bedolobha elilodwa, futhi kunenye inhlolovo ebonisa ukuthi ukugwema kwanda. A: Ukuba khona kokugwema akwenzi umthetho ungabi nasisindo. Noma abanye bewugwema, isikhathi sokuxhuma ngokwaso sehlile. B: Angisho ukuthi awunasisindo; ngisho ukuthi sidinga ukuba nokuqapha okwengeziwe ekushoneni ubukhulu bomphumela.
texts.g:b25acd75: Inkampani isho ukuthi iholo layo eliphakathi labasebenzi liphakathi kwamaphezulu embonini. Kodwa leli phakathi lihlanganisa iholo labaphathi abathathu. Inkampani ihlela ukunciphisa uhhafu usayizi wokuqasha abasha kulo nyaka uma kuqhathaniswa nonyaka odlule. Inyunyana yabasebenzi ithi uma abaphathi bekhishwa futhi i-median ibalwa, inani liyehluleka ngisho nokufinyelela iphakathi lembonini. Kodwa inkampani ayizange idalule ukuthi ibale kanjani iphakathi, futhi nokubala kwenyunyana akuzange kube nomthombo wedatha wethulwe. Umusho wokukhangisa nawo ubekwe ebhodini lezaziso langaphakathi.
texts.g:ba65edb4: Kunzima ukufinyelela esiphethweni esiqinile ngomphumela wenqubomgomo ngalo mphumela kuphela.
texts.g:89ee8852: Ngaphambi kokunquma ukuthi kwethulwe uhlelo, ukuhlolwa kwemiphumela emibi elindelekile kumele kuze kuqala.
texts.g:6170ca92: Uma le ncazelo isebenza, kubonakala sengathi ithiyori ekhona kuzodingeka ibuyekezwe.
texts.g:1cacfd4d: Njengoba usayizi wesampula ungeneli, lo mphumela kufanele wamukelwe njengesikhashana.
texts.g:05b58da0: Kwakhuliswa ithemba lokuthi, uma imithetho ikhululwa, ukungena kwezinkampani ezintsha kuzoba nomdlandla.
texts.g:b2b9a6fb: Umbiko okukhulunywa ngawo cishe uzothola kunzima ukugwema ukugxekwa ngokuthi weqisa ukukhulisa imiphumela yenqubomgomo.
texts.g:c588c2f4: Lesi simo sichazwa njengomphumela wezinto eziningana ezisebenza ndawonye kunembangela eyodwa.
texts.g:5e706eae: Uma ububanzi benkulumo buqhutshwa, kukhona ukukhathazeka ukuthi udaba oluyisisekelo lungase lufiphale.
texts.g:854277b6: Abanye abacwaningi baphikisa ngokuthi ukusebenzisa amaholo aphansi ahlukene ngesifunda kuzovusa imisebenzi ezifundeni. Basho ukuthi uma izindleko zabasebenzi zehla, izindawo ezincane zokusebenza zithola amandla okuqasha abaningi. Lo mbono awunasisekelo ngokuphelele. Kodwa-ke, uma isikhala samaholo sikhula, intsha ingase isuke kakhulu iye endaweni yedolobha elikhulu, futhi amandla abasebenzi basekhaya uqobo angase anciphe. Uma kungasekho muntu osele ukusebenza, imisebenzi eyengeziwe nayo ngeke igcwaliswe. Ngakho, ukusebenzisa okuhlukile kufanele kucatshangelwe kuphela lapho kulungiswa izinyathelo ezengeziwe zokumisa ukuphuma kwabantu ngasikhathi sinye.
texts.g:b2bd772f: Kuqhubeka kwenzeka izimo lapho izikhungo zokuphatha, ngisho nangemva kokwamukela isicelo solwazi lomphakathi, zibamba amadokhumenti zicaphuna ukuvikelwa kolwazi lomuntu siqu. Akekho ophikisana nokuthi ukuvikela ulwazi lomuntu siqu kuyinani elibalulekile. Kodwa ukufihla yonke into ngisho namadokhumenti ayengakhishwa uma nje imininingwane ekhomba umuntu njengamagama noma amakheli ayemboziwe kusondelene nokugwema isibopho kunokuvikela. Ukungadalulwa kufanele kube yisihlukanisi, futhi lapho kusetshenziswa isihlukanisi, isikhungo kumele siqinisekise isidingo. Ekugcineni, inkinga akukhona ukuthi kudalulwe noma cha, kodwa ukuthi kudingeka kumbozwe kuze kube kuphi.
texts.g:e39bdff0: Ngemva kokuba isikhungo socwaningo samemezele imiphumela yocwaningo ebonisa ukuthi abafundi abagwema ukudla kwasekuseni banamamaki aphansi, isimangalo sasakazeka sokuthi ukudla kwasekuseni kukhuphula amamaki. Ucwaningo luqinisekisa ngempela ukuthi izinguquko ezimbili ziyahambisana. Kodwa ukuze lokhu kubalwe njengobufakazi bembangela, kumele kukhishwe umthelela wezinye izinto njengezimo zomndeni noma isikhathi sokulala. Lolu cwaningo alulawulanga lezi zinto. Ngakho, imiphumela ibonisa kuphela ukuhlobana, futhi isanele ukuba isisekelo sesincomo senqubomgomo yokudla kwasekuseni.
texts.g:fc68b080: Isimiso sokuthi ifomu lokuqala kumele lilondolozwe liphelele lapho kubuyiselwa ifa lamasiko samukelwa kabanzi. Ukukhathazeka ngokuthi ukugcwalisa izingxenye ezonakele ngezinto ezintsha kuyaphazamisa ubuqiniso bomlando nakho kunenzuzo. Kodwa-ke, uma umuntu ephikelela ekulondolozeni kokuqala kuphela futhi ayinaki isakhiwo esiwayo, into ethembisile ukuvikelwa uqobo iyanyamalala. Ubuqiniso abuveli ekulondolozeni izinto zakudala kuphela kodwa nasekusheni ngokusobala ukuthi iziphi izingxenye ezibuyisiwe. Ngakho, kungcono ukubuyisa kuphela kangako ngokudingekayo futhi ukurekhoda izingxenye ezibuyisiwe ngokucacile.
texts.g:15ba669d: Uhulumeni wasekhaya ugcine uhlelo lokuhlola lesibonelelo sezindlu futhi wamemezela ukuthi ukwaneliseka phakathi kwemindeni etholile kweqe amaphesenti angu-90. Umuzwa wokuthi isibonelelo sisizile ngempela unencazelo. Kodwa ukwaneliseka kubonisa kuphela ukubonga abathole abakuzwile futhi akulinganisi ngokuqondile ukuthi ukuzinza kwezindlu kuthuthukile ngempela. Ukumemezela uhlelo njengempumelelo ngaphandle kwezinkomba eziyisihloko njengenani lokukhuthuka noma izikweletu zokuqasha kusenesikhathi. Ukuthi ukwandisa noma cha kungenziwa ngemva kokuqinisekisa lezo zinkomba, futhi bekungeke kube sekwephuzile.
texts.g:25fd318d: Uhlelo lwe-sunset, olunikeza imithetho isikhathi sokusebenza, luthathwa njengesisetshenziswa esivimbela imithetho engadingekile ukuthi ihlale endaweni. Uma umthetho ushabalala ngokuzenzakalelayo ngosuku olumisiwe, umnyango ophethe awunakho ukunqaba ukuphinda ucabange ngesidingo sawo. Nokho, uma ngisho nemithetho ehlobene nokuphepha ichithwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, kuvela izikhala futhi umonakalo uwela kozakwabo. Ukuze kufezekiswe inhloso yohlelo lwe-sunset, ukuqina kokubuyekezwa kokwelulwa kufanele kwehluke ngokuya ngohlobo lomthetho kunokuphatha yonke imithetho ngezinga elifanayo.
texts.g:d78ca367: Kunombono othi imiphumela yasebhokisini lamathikithi iqinisekisa inani lomsebenzi. Iqiniso lokuthi ababukeli abaningi bawukhethile luphawu okungenakunganakwa. Nokho, ngoba inani lababukeli nalo liphethwe ubukhulu bokukhangiswa nenani lezikrini, akunakuba ngokushesha isilinganiso sekhwalithi yobuciko. Kunalokho, ukubuka ukuthi izethameli zasabela kanjani ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo nokuthi ukukhulunywa ngomlomo kwaqhubeka isikhathi eside yini kusondela kakhulu ekuhlolweni okunembe kakhulu. Ngakho-ke, impumelelo yebhokisi lamathikithi iyindawo yokuqala kuphela yokuhlola futhi ayinakuba isiphetho.

texts.n:k.k10.media_article:academicHedge: Ukubhala kwezemfundo kunciphisa izimangalo ngamaphethini amisiwe afana no 'kungaba', 'kungase', no 'kunzima ukuqinisa' esikhundleni sokusho ukuqiniseka.

texts.g:8c8e1913: Amanye amaqembu aphinde aveze ukukhathazeka ngokuthi lesi sinyathelo singase, kunalokho, sijulise ukudideka kwemakethe.
texts.g:b7a6d5ec: Ocwaningweni lwesikhungo socwaningo kubasebenzi basehhovisi abayinkulungwane, ama-68 amaphesenti ababuzwayo ababeke basebenza ukusebenza kude bathi ukwaneliseka ngomsebenzi wabo kukhuphukile. texts.g:309b4d03:
[Isaziso] Ukulungiswa kwezindawo zomtapo wolwazi wedolobha
Umtapo wolwazi wedolobha uzovala okwesikhashana amakamelo okufundela amasonto amabili, kusuka ngoMashi 4 kuya ngoMashi 17, ngenxa yomsebenzi wokulungisa izindawo. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ukuboleka nokubuyisa izincwadi kuyaqhubeka njengenjwayelo edeskini lolwazi lesitezi sokuqala. Siyacela ukuqonda kwenu ngokuphazamiseka okubangelwa umsindo wokwakha.
texts.g:bfc7a9a5: Muva nje, izicelo zabahlali zokwakha izindawo zezinja kuphela ezingadini zasedolobheni ziya ngokukhula. Ihhovisi lesifunda linqume ukumisa izindawo ezimbili zokuhlola kulo nyaka kanye nokunquma ngokwandiswa ngemva kokuhlola izimo zokwephulwa kwemithetho nenani lezikhalazo. Nokho, abanye abahlali baveza ukuphikisa, bephawula ngomsindo nezinkinga zobumsulwa.
texts.g:3e0d9d66: Muva nje, ezinye izikhulu zomkhandlu zikhuphisana ekumemezeleni ukuthi zakha indawo yepaki yasedolobheni engakanani. Kodwa indawo yepaki ayisho ngokwayo impilo engcono yezakhamuzi. Noma izindawo ezinkulu eziluhlaza zakhiwa emaphethelweni lapho ukufinyelela kunzima, abahlali bazozithola zinzima ukuzisebenzisa empilweni yansuku zonke. Impumelelo yenqubomgomo kufanele ilinganiswe hhayi ngokuthi kutholwe umhlaba onganani kodwa ngokuthi zingaki izakhamuzi ezijabulela eduze nekhaya. Uma ihlala emjahweni wezinombolo, inqubomgomo yezindawo eziluhlaza ayikwazi ukubalekela ukugxekwa ngokuthi kuwukuphatha okwenzelwa ukubukwa.
texts.g:a534b217: Lolu cwaningo lwahlaziya imiphumela yokwethula amahora okusebenza aguquguqukayo ezinkampanini ezincane nezimaphakathi ezingu-320 esifundeni sasenhloko-dolobha. Ukuphuma kwabasebenzi kwehle ngokwesilinganiso ngamaphoyinti angama-3.1 amaphesenti ezinkampanini ezamukele uhlelo, kodwa isixhumanisi nokukhula kwezthengiso asibalulekile ngokwezibalo. Nokho, ngenxa yokuthi isampula ithambekele emikhakheniethile, kunemikhawulo ekujwayeliseni imiphumela. Ngakho ucwaningo olulandelayo ludinga ukuhlola kabusha umphumela emikhakheni nasezingeni lezinkampani ezihlukene.
texts.g:e48636af: Uhulumeni unqume ukwandisa isabelomali sakhe sokubhekana nezinga eliphansi lokuzalwa ngezigaba kusukela onyakeni ozayo. Nokho, uhlelo lwehluke kwezangaphambilini ngoba lushiya ukwesekwa ngemali futhi lugxile ekwakheni ingqalasizinda yokunakekelwa kwezingane. Uhulumeni wabheka ukuthi izibonelelo zokubeletha kuphela zinganqoba kanzima izimbangela eziyisisekelo ezithinta isinqumo sokuba nengane, okungukuthi umthwalo wokukhulisa izingane nobunzima bokulinganisa umsebenzi nomndeni. Ngokufanele uhlela ukufaka ngaphezu kwengxenye yesabelomali ekwandiseni izikhungo zokunakekela izingane zasemini nezindawo zokunakekelwa ngemva kwesikole.
texts.g:58d6ef44: Isimangalo sokuthi ulimi alulona nje isitsha somcabango kodwa isikhunta esenza indlela esicabanga ngayo sesikhona isikhathi eside. Lokhu yilokho okubizwa ngokuthi ukucatshangwa kokuhlobana kolimi. Ucwaningo lwakamuva luthambekele ekungasekeli lo mcabango ngokuqinile kodwa lwamukela ngendlela ephakathi: ukuthi ulimi lungathinta ngobuciko isivinini lapho kubonwa izigaba ezithile noma isiqondiso sokunaka. Ngamanye amazwi, lubona ulimi njengolithonya amathambekela omcabango kunokunquma umcabango.
texts.g:de67f65c: Ngemva kokuba isibhedlela sendawo simemezele ukuthi sizonqamula ukunakekelwa kwasebusuku, imibhikisho evela kubahlali iqhubekile. Isibhedlela sakhomba ukuntuleka kwabasebenzi bezempilo namaphutha ezimali. Kodwa uma ukunakekelwa kwasebusuku kunyamalala, abokuqala ukuhlupheka abantu asebekhulile, abanganakho ukuthutha okulula. Asikwazi ukuphika ngokuphelele umqondo wokuphatha wesibhedlela, kodwa asikwazi ukungabuza ukuthi ngempela kuyalingana yini ukwahlulela insizakalo yomphakathi kakhulu efana nokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngenzuzo kuphela. Yingakho izinyathelo zokweseka ezivela kuhulumeni wendawo kufanele ziye ndawonye.
texts.g:6e1dc6da: Abacwaningi balandela abafundi abangu-480 bezikole zamabanga aphansi iminyaka emibili ukuze bahlole ubudlelwano phakathi kobuningi bokufunda nezinhlu zamagama. Iqembu elifunde kakhulu libonise amamaki aphakeme ezinhlu zamagama. Nokho, abacwaningi abazange baphethe ngalokhu ukuthi ukufunda kwenyusa izinhlu zamagama. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi abakwazi ukungafaki ithuba lokuthi izingane ebezivele zinezinhlu zamagama eziqinile zazijabulela ukufunda kakhulu kusukela ekuqaleni. Ukuqinisekisa ubudlelwano besizathu, bangeza, kufanele kulandele ucwaningo lokuhlola olushintsha ngamabomu indawo yokufunda.
texts.g:9de5619c: Ikomiti lethu liyayiqonda inhloso yalesi sichibiyelo. Nokho, siyakholelwa ukuthi kudingeka indlela enokuqaphela ekuhlelweni kwendlela usuku lokuqalisa olwandulelwa ngayo. Izindawo zokusebenza ezincane zithola kunzima ukuthola abasebenzi nemali ukuze zihlangabezane nezindinganiso ezintsha ngesikhathi esifushane, futhi uma izindinganiso ziqiniswa ngaphandle kokulungiselela kunengozi yokuthi ukuvalwa kwanda ngokuphambene nenhloso. Ngakho ikomiti linxusa ukumisa izikhathi zomusa ngokosayizi nokunikeza ukwesekwa kwezobuchwepheshe ngaleso sikhathi.
texts.g:45b728fe: Abasebenzi ababuthana emadolobheni ngesikhathi sokuqala semboni bazithola behlala ezindlini ezimbi. Abafundile balesosikhathi baphendula kule nkinga ngezindlela ezimbili ezibanzi. Uhlangothi olulodwa lwakhomba ukuthambekela kokungaziphathi kahle komuntu ngamunye njengesizathu futhi lwagcizelela ukuguqulwa kwesimilo, kanti olunye lwafuna isizathu ekungalinganini kwezakhiwo futhi lwafuna ukuthuthukiswa kwezikhungo. Iqiniso lokuthi impikiswano yanamuhla ngenqubomgomo yobubha ifana nalokhu kuphikisana kwangaphambili libonisa ukujula kwezimpande zenkinga.
texts.g:894393a9: Iqembu lezakhamuzi lifune ukuthi umkhandlu wendawo wandise ububanzi bemizuzu yawo eyashicilelwe. Umkhandlu ubugcine okunye okuqukethwe kuvaliwe ngesizathu sokuthi kungase kuhlasele ubumfihlo babakhulumi. Kodwa izitatimende zomphakathi kufanele zibhekwe umphakathi, futhi ukufihla ngisho izingxoxo zenqubomgomo ezingahlobene nobumfihlo akunakho ukukholisa okukhulu. Ububanzi bolwazi okufanele luvikelwe kufanele kucaciswe ngokuqondile, kanti konke okunye kwenziwe kube sesidlangalaleni njengomthetho. Umkhuba wokugwema ukudalula uwumkhandlu ngokwawo ushabalalisa ukwethemba.
texts.g:ce1b883f: Lolu cwaningo lubonisa ukuthi kukhona ukuhlobana okuphawulekayo phakathi kwemikhuba yokuzivivinya nezimpawu zokudangala.
texts.g:88eee315: Uma lokhu kuqhubeka, ukwehla kwesifunda kungashesha.
texts.g:28c887ae: Kubikwa ukuthi umonakalo wakhula ngoba akubanga khona impendulo esheshayo.
texts.g:a69a2570: Nakuba inhloso yenqubomgomo ilungile, imibuzo isekhona ngokulingana kokuyisebenzisa.
texts.g:d7136abe: Umhlahlandlela ugxekwa ngokuthi usabhekelwe ngokungenele emkhakheni ngisho nangemva kokubuyekezwa kwawo.
texts.g:49a29231: Ochwepheshe baqagele ukuthi lesi sinyathelo singase sikhiqize imiphumela yesikhathi esifushane kuphela.
texts.g:6916a3e8: Umbono wokuthi lolu daba kufanele lubhekwe njengenkinga yesakhiwo kunokuphambuka komuntu ngamunye nje uya ngokuba nokukholisa.
texts.g:58a6978f: Uhulumeni wasekhaya umemezele ukuthi ukuthengiswa kwezimpahla endaweni yakhe kukhuphuke ngama-12 amaphesenti ngemva kokukhipha amavawusha amaningi esipho sasendaweni. Kodwa ngesikhathi esifanayo ukuthengiswa endaweni engumakhelwane kukhuphuke ngelinganayo, futhi ngaphezu kwengxenye yokusetshenziswa kwamavawusha kwenzeka ezitolo ezinkulu ebezivele zinamakhasimende amaningi aphelele. Isikhungo sengeze ukuthi le datha yodwa yenza kube nzima ukusho ukuthi amavawusha adale ukusetshenziswa okusha noma ashintshe indlela yokukhokha yemali ebisivele ihlelelwe ukusetshenziswa. Uhulumeni wasekhaya wathi uhlela ukuqhubeka nokukhipha ngesilinganiso esifanayo ekota ezayo.
texts.g:c70cd192: Umkhandlu wedolobha uphasise umthetho wesifunda ophoqa izimoto zokulethwa kwempahla ezigibela emgwaqweni wabahamba ngezinyawo, kodwa unqume ukuhlehlisa ukuphoqelelwa kwawo ngonyaka owodwa. Amalungu omkhandlu athi akukho ukungavumelani mayelana nesidingo sokuphoqelela. Kodwa-ke, kuphawuliwe ukuthi uma izinhlawulo zibekwa kuqala ngaphandle kokucabangela isakhiwo semali engenayo yabasebenzi bokulethwa kwempahla, ukwephulwa komthetho kungase kubuyele ezindaweni ezingabonakali kakhulu. Idolobha lichaze ukuthi lizoyandisa izindawo zokumisa okwesikhashana ngesikhathi sobubele. Isichibiyelo sipasiswe ngokuvunyelwa iningi lamalungu ayekhona.
texts.g:7363c671: Ezinye izindlu zocwaningo ezintathu zazame ukuphinda zikhiqize isakhiwo sokuqhuba ugesi ngokuphelele sempahla entsha eyamenyezelwa yithimba elilodwa locwaningo, kodwa ezimbili zahluleka. Ithimba lokuqala liphendule ngokuthi ukwehlukana kokumsulwa kwesampula kungaba yimbangela. Ngisho nendlu yocwaningo eyodwa eyaphumelela yathi ububanzi bezinga lokushisa lokulinganisa bwehlukile, okwenza ukuqhathanisa okuqondile kwemiphumela kube nzima. Umphakathi wesayensi awuyilahli ngokushesha le miphumela njengephutha, futhi awuyemukeli njengempumelelo. Ukuze lempahla ibe nomsebenzi ongokoqobo, kumele kuqale kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isakhiwo esifanayo siyavela yini ezingeni lokushisa legumbi.
texts.g:04ed4bbd: Abahwebi bathi njengoba imakethe yendabuko yaziwa njengendawo yezivakashi, izivakashi zenyuke kakhulu kodwa amakhasimende avamile ancipha. Inhlangano yokuphatha imakethe ihlola ukuthi ukuthengisa kukhuphuke ngenxa yezivakashi zangaphandle. Kodwa-ke, abanye abahwebi bachaza imakethe yanamuhla ngokuthi 'usuku lwemakethe luyabanjwa, kodwa imakethe seyanyamalala.' Umhwebi othe lokhu uvumile ukuthi ukuthengisa kwansuku zonke kwenyuke ngempela, kodwa kwanyamalala kancane. Inhlangano ithe ihlela ukwandisa izikhungo zolwazi lwezivakashi ngonyaka ozayo.
texts.g:28accf58: Uhulumeni umemezele ukuthi kulo nyaka abantu abaneminyaka engama-60 noma ngaphezulu bakha ngaphezu kwamaphesenti angama-20 sezigaba zonke zabaqashiwe okokuqala ngqa. Kodwa-ke, uma izibalo zihlukaniswa, iningi lokwanda lavela emisebenzini yomphakathi yesikhashana engaphansi kwamahora angama-15 ngesonto, futhi inkomba yemali engenayo yenyanga ngayinye yehle ngempela. Ukugxekwa kokuthi izinga lokuqashwa njengenkomba lihluleka ukubonisa ikhwalithi yomsebenzi kuphinde kwenziwa nalokhu. Isikhulu sikahulumeni sithe ukuhlaziywa okuhlukile ngezigaba ezinemininingwane kuzokhishwa inyanga ezayo. Ochwepheshe bakholelwa ukuthi inani elifanayo lingaholela ekuhlolweni kwenqubomgomo okuhlukile kuye ngokuhumusha.
texts.g:c7538eaa: Emhlanganweni wokuhumusha, umethuli wakhomba ukuthi lapho igama lolimi lomthombo linenhlonipho yesiko elikhulu, lapho kuzanywa ukuthola nokusebenzisa elilingana nalo kakhulu, incazelo iyaba ncane. Wavuma ukuthi ukuphikisana, okuthi ukwengeza amanothi aphansi kuphula ukuzithoba komfundi, kunokuthile okufanele ukuvunywa. Noma kunjalo, uthe ufuna ukwenza kucace ukuthi ukuhumusha okulula ukufundwa akusona ngempela ukuhumusha okwethembekile kwasekuqaleni. Umhlangano unqume ukwenza lolu daba ibe isihloko sengxoxo esisemthethweni emhlanganweni wonyaka ozayo.
texts.g:8ba74f1e: Isikhungo sikahulumeni sathi sizovula amarekhodi okunyakaza kwezakhamuzi, anamagama namakheli asusiwe, kubacwaningi. Isikhungo sachaza ukuthi njengoba lonke ulwazi oluhlonza luphelisiwe, akukho ukukhathazeka ngokuhlaselwa kwemfihlo. Kodwa-ke, isazi somthetho sakhomba ukuthi ucwaningo lwakwamanye amazwe lubike amacala lapho abantu abathile bengakhethwa ngezindlela zokuya emsebenzini nezikhathi kuphela. Isikhungo asizange sinikeze isimo esihlukile kulokhu. Usuku lokukhishwa kwedatha alukamiswa.
texts.n:k.k10.media_headline:nounEnd: Izihloko zezindaba ngokuvamile ziphela ngebizo noma ibinzana lebizo futhi ziyeka iziphetho zezenzo, ngakho isihloko sifundwa njengesitatimende esinciphisiwe.
texts.n:k.k10.media_headline:commaClause: Ikhoma esihlokweni livame ukuhlanganisa izingxenye ezimbili ezinciphisiwe, njengembangela noma umcimbi olandelwa umphumela wawo.

texts.g:cc58d1d9:
[Izindaba ezishisayo] Idolobha linciphisa umkhawulo wejubane edolobheni libe ngu-40 km/h, kusukela ngenyanga ezayo
Kusukela ngenyanga ezayo, idolobha lizokunciphisa umkhawulo wejubane emigwaqweni emikhulu yedolobha usuka ku-50 uye ku-40 amakhilomitha ngehora. Idolobha lithe izingozi zabahambi ngezinyawo zehlile ngesikhathi sokuzama, nokuthi lihlela ukuhlaziya umphumela futhi ngemva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha bese linquma ukuthi lizokwelulwa yini kwezinye izindlela.
texts.g:79a97f3d: Izinkomba zemisebenzi ziyathuthuka, kodwa abantu abasha abadala bahlala bemile
texts.g:e5a860f5: Inhloso yokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwekhabhoni ilungiselelwe phezulu

texts.g:8df1fdab: Ihhovisi lezemfundo ledolobha lamemezele ukuthi kusukela ngesemester elandelayo lizolwelula ukunakekelwa ngemva kwesikole ezikoleni zamabanga aphansi kuze kube ngu-7 p.m.
texts.g:91094162: Ochwepheshe bahlaziye ukuthi, ngalesi sinyathelo kuphela, ukukhuphuka kwamanani akuyikuba lula ukukwehlisa.
texts.g:ed0ce6a5: Ukuthunyelwa phesheya kwenyanga edlule, kusizwa yimiphumela eqinile ye-semiconductor, kufinyelele izinga eliphezulu kunawo wonke kuleyo nyanga.
texts.g:eca8dbcf:
[Isifinyezo] Ukuvulwa kwelayibhrari kusihlwa kuzokwandiswa... abasebenzisi bagculisekile kakhulu
Idolobha lithe ukwaneliseka kwabasebenzisi ngokuvulwa kwamalayibhrari omphakathi kusihlwa, okwenziwa njengesivivinyo kulo nyaka, kwakuphezulu. Iningi labaphendulile lathi kulula ngoba bangaboleka izincwadi ngisho nangemva komsebenzi. Ngokususelwe kule miphumela, idolobha lihlela ukwengeza amalayibhrari ayishumi avulwa kusihlwa unyaka ozayo.
texts.g:f804296d: Iphephandaba lishicilele isihloko esithi 'Umphumela wezibonelelo zabasunguli abasha ufakazelwe'. Kodwa emzimbeni, izinga lokusinda konyaka owodwa kwabathola isibonelelo laliphezulu ngamaphuzu angu-2 kuphela kunqeqebana lokuqhathanisa, futhi abacwaningi bathe isampula lincane futhi kunzima ukwenza ukuhlanganisa. Ngale ndlela isihloko sibeka isimangalo esinamandla kunesiphetho esiqapheleyo somzimba.
texts.g:593213fa: Umkhuba wokusebenzisa amafomu ombuzo ezihlokweni zezindaba uyakhula. Kunokuzivikela okuthi kuveza ukucophelela ekungashiyeni amaqiniso angaqinisekisiwe. Kodwa isihloko esinjengokuthi 'Isibonelelo: sizosebenza?' sishiya abafundi nomuzwa ongemuhle kuphela nakuba umzimba ungenayo impendulo. Kufana nokungenisa isimangalo ngokuthula ngokuboleka ifomu lombuzo. Abafundi bavame ukudlula nje esihlokweni, ngakho abatholi ithuba lokulungisa lo muzwa. Isihloko sefomu lombuzo singalungisiswa kuphela uma umzimba wethula izizathu zalowo mbuzo.
texts.g:0e25e2a6: Njengoba umjaho wezindaba ezishisayo ukhula, ulwazi olungaqinisekisiwe luvame ukungena ezihlokweni. Njengoba abafundi befuna izindaba ezisheshayo, ijubane uqobo alikwazi ukusolwa. Kodwa ngisho noma iphutha lilungiswa kamuva, umuzwa oshiywe yisihloko sokuqala awususwa kalula, ngoba izindatshana zokulungisa azifundwa ngokubanzi njengeyokuqala. Ukuthi ijubane nokunemba kuyaqubuzana akusho ukuthi kufanele kuxazululwe ngokufinyeza isigaba sokuqinisekisa. Ngisho noma sekwephuzile, ukushicilela kuphela amaqiniso aqinisekisiwe kuyindlela yokugcina ukwethenjwa.
texts.g:53030fa1: Isihloko esithi 'Izingozi zamabhayisikili zikhulelwe kabili' sibamba ukunaka kwabafundi ngaso leso sikhathi. Kuyamukeleka ukusho ukuthi ukubeka izinga lokushintsha kuqala kuyindlela esebenzayo yokucindezela ulwazi. Kodwa uma inani eliyisisekelo lincane, 'kabili' kusho okuncane, ngoba isihloko esifanayo bekungenzeka lapho icala elilodwa laba mabili. Ngokuphambene, uma amakhulu amacala eba kabili, isihloko esifanayo sasingaba nesisindo esihlukile kakhulu. Uma izinga lokushintsha lisetshenziswa esihlokweni, umzimba kufanele ubonise nenani lokuqala ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukulinganisa isikali.
texts.g:bc267d69: Ukubeka izimpawu zokucaphuna esihlokweni nokudlulisa isitatimende njengoba sinjalo kukwenza kubukeke njengokulethwa okuqondile ngaphandle kokuzizwa kombiki. Ngempela, le ndlela iyasiza ekudluliseni isitatimende uqobo ngokwethembeka. Kodwa uma kukhethwa kuphela igama elivusa kakhulu esitatimendeni eside futhi libekwe esihlokweni, ukucaphuna kuba ukukhetha kunokulethwa. Izimpawu zokucaphuna zingase zingabi isiqinisekiso sokunemba kodwa umkhondo wokuhlela. Abafundi kufanele bahlole emzimbeni ukuthi amazwi ngaphakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna anqunywe kanjani esimweni sawo.
texts.g:63ea35cf: Izindatshana zezindaba zilandela isakhiwo se-inverted-pyramid esibeka umongo esigabeni sokuqala. Lesi sakhiwo sisebenza kahle ngoba sivumela abafundi ukuthi bathole umongo ngisho nalapho behamba ngemva kokufunda ingxenye yokuqala kuphela. Nokho, uma udaba luyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, ukubeka isiphetho kuphela esigabeni sokuqala kuphushela izimfanelo nezimpikiswano ngemuva, kangangokuthi abafundi abafunda ukuqala kuphela baqonda amaqiniso ngokulula kakhulu. Isimo ngokwaso sokuthi abafundi abaningi abafundi kuze kube sekugcineni siba ubuthakathaka balesi sakhiwo. Kungcono ukufingqa esigabeni sokuqala kodwa ufake nesimo esibaluleke kakhulu esisodwa.
texts.g:31402c52: Umfundi obona isihloko 'Amanani abathengi ayehla' angaqonda kalula ukuthi amanani ehlile. Kungasho ukuthi kuyisimo esijwayelekile kubantu abafunda izindaba zomnotho ukuthi leli gama elifushaniswe lisho ukuthi isimo sokukhuphuka sesinciphile. Nokho, hhayi bonke abafundi abahlanganyela kulesi sisekelo, futhi uma kugcizelelwa 'ukuhamba kancane' kuphela kanti amazinga amanani asephezulu, kungasakaza ithemba elingahambisani nokuzwa kwabantu. Lapho kufinyezwa amagama obuchwepheshe, kufanele kucatshangwe kuqala ukuthi abafundi banalo yini isisekelo esifanayo.
texts.g:87c0595a: Igama elithi 'impikiswano' livame ukusetshenziswa ezihlokweni zezindaba. Kufanele kuvunywe ukuthi liyigama elilula lokubika ngokufishane udaba lapho imibono ihlukene. Kodwa ekusebenzeni, 'impikiswano' inamathiselwa ngisho nasekugxekweni okuphakanyiswa abambalwa noma ezinsolweni ezingenasisekelo esiqinile, kwenze kubonakale sengathi umphakathi wonke wehlukene. texts.g:0c1b4b47: Iphephandaba lithe, ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi 'Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuyakhuphuka, uphawu lobunzima,' izinga lokuntuleka kwemisebenzi kwale nyanga likhuphuke ngamaphuzu angu-0.3 lisuka enyangeni edlule laya ku-3.4 amaphesenti. Kodwa-ke, isimemezelo se-Employment Trends Institute sithi ucwaningo lubhekise emizini yesampula futhi lunephutha lezibalo elingaphezulu noma eliphansi ngamaphuzu angu-0.4. Ushintsho oluphakathi kwemikhawulo yephutha lunzima ukuhlukanisa njengoshintsho lwangempela noma umphumela wethuba wokukhetha isampula. Ngakho, ngisho noma umzimba wendatshana udlulisela izibalo ezinembile, inkulumo ethi 'kuyakhuphuka' esihlokweni inamandla kunencazelo izibalo ezivumela yona. Kuphephe kakhulu ukuhlulela ngemva kokuhlola ukugeleza phakathi kwezinyanga eziningana kunokuthatha ukuguquguquka kwenyanga eyodwa.
texts.g:b5385d29: Ocwaningweni lwemibono ngohlelo lokuthuthukisa idolobha elisha, amaphesenti angu-48 ayekuvuma futhi angu-45 ayephikisa, futhi isiqaphi sizindaba sibike 'Umbono wokuthuthukisa uholela.' Iphutha lokukhetha isampula lalolu cwaningo lingaphezulu noma liphansi ngamaphuzu angu-3.1 ezingeni lokuzethemba lamaphesenti angu-95. Ngoba umehluko wamaphuzu angu-3 phakathi kokusekela nokuphikisa uphakathi kwemikhawulo yephutha, umuntu akakwazi ukusho ngokwezibalo ukuthi uhlangothi luni olukhulu. Esimweni esinjalo, ukubhala 'umbono wehlukene ngokulinganayo' kuyinkulumo ethembekile kakhulu kudatha. Umbiko oqhubela usayizi wezinombolo ngqo ekuhlelweni kwamazinga ungase ufundeke kubafundi njengeqiniso elinqunyiwe.
texts.g:408798cc: Iphephandaba lasekhaya lishicilele isihloko esithi 'Izingozi zamabhayisikili esifundeni zikhulelwe kabili.' Uma ubheka umzimba, inani lezingozi likhuphuke lisuka ku-3 onyakeni odlule laya ku-6 kulo nyaka. Ngokwesilinganiso kuphela kungukukhuphuka okungamaphesenti angu-100, kodwa ngoba inani eliphelele lincane, ngisho nomehluko wethuba wecala elilodwa noma amabili ushintsha isilinganiso kakhulu. Ngokuphambene, izingozi zezimoto endaweni efanayo zikhuphuke ngamaphesenti angu-5, kusuka ku-1,200 kuya ku-1,260, kodwa azange zifinyelele esihlokweni. Luhlangothi luni ingozi abafundi abayidinga ngempela ukuyazi? Umuntu akufanele afunde isilinganiso esigcizelelwe yisihloko njengesikhombisa ngokuqondile ukubaluleka kwendatshana.
texts.g:f1021423: Kugrafu yebha esihlokweni esisodwa, ukuqashiswa okuphakathi kweSifunda A kudwetshwe ngokuphakama okungaphezu kokuphindwe kabili kwesiFunda B. Kodwa i-axis eqondile yaqala hhayi ku-0 kodwa ku-800,000 won. Izibalo zangempela zingu-920,000 won ngo-A no-850,000 won ngo-B, umehluko ongaphezu kancane kwamaphesenti angu-8. Uma indawo yokuqala inqunyiwe, ngisho nomehluko omncane ubukeka njengesikhala esikhulu. Ngisho noma isimo segrafu sibonakala sisekela isimangalo sesihloko, abafundi badonswa yisithombe esibonakalayo ngaphandle uma behlola isikali namayunithi.
texts.g:9369abc2: Ezihlokweni zesimo sezulu, inkulumo ethi 'izinga lokushisa eliphezulu kusukela kwaqala amarekhodi' idinga ukucophelela ekuhumusheni. Isibonelo, indawo yokubuka i-Onsaemi ibhale amazinga okushisa kusukela ngo-1998, ngakho 'kusukela kwaqala amarekhodi' kwayo kuwukuhleleka kuphela kurekhodi lweminyaka engaba ngamashumi amabili. Ayikwazi ukubekwa eceleni futhi iqhathaniswe namarekhodi ezinye izindawo ezibukele cishe ikhulu leminyaka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma izindawo ezizungezile indawo yokubuka sezibe yidolobha futhi ukushisa kuqoqeka kalula, izimbangela zokukhuphuka kokushisa zihlanganisa izinguquko endaweni yendawo kanye nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu. Ngakho le nkulumo ingaba yiqiniso, kodwa lokho akusho ngokuqondile ukuthi kungubufakazi obuqondile bokuguquka kwesimo sezulu.
texts.g:f28ddb3b: Isihloko sesihloko esisodwa sifundeka 'I-additive yokudla A inyusa ingozi yomdlavuza.' Kodwa umcwaningi okucashunwe kuye emzimbeni nje wathi, 'Ezivivinyweni zezigcawu kwakukhona izimo lapho izimila zandile ngamadosi aphezulu, ngakho asikwazi ukukhipha ithuba lengozi nakubantu.' Le nkulumo isondele ekutheni ingozi ayikakhishwa kunokuthi ingozi iqinisekisiwe. Isihloko sasusa isimo 'ithuba' nomkhawulo 'isivivinyo sezigcawu' sashiya isiphetho kuphela. Ukucashunwa kwenkulumo akusho ukuthi ukucophelela kwayo kudluliselwe nayo.
texts.g:8f4d8e8f: Abafundi ababone isihloko esithi 'Iholo eliphakathi labasebenzi basehhovisi: ama-won ayizigidi ezingu-52' baba nokukhathazeka ukuthi imali yabo incane kunephakathi. Kodwa ithebula locwaningo olufanayo lalibala okuphakathi (median) njengama-won ayizigidi ezingu-41. Ukuthi iphakathi liphezulu ngaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-10 zama-won kunomedian kusho ukuthi inani elincane labaholela kakhulu lakhuphula iphakathi. Kudatha esabalalisiwe ngohlangothi olulodwa, njengemali engenayo, iphakathi lingase lehluleke ukumela isimo sabantu abejwayelekile. Inombolo esetshenziswe esihlokweni ayizange ibe yiphutha, kodwa ukukhathazeka abafundi abakuzwile kuvela kakhulu ekukhetheni isikhombisi.

texts.g:f8424b93: Wayezigabisile ngokuba ohlakaniphe kakhulu, kodwa lapho ehlangana nomphikisi ongcono kakhulu emncintiswaneni wazizwa ngempela ukuthi kuhlale kukhona ongcono.
texts.g:81648b2d: Ibhokisi lokudla lomngane wami lalibukeka lihlwabusa kakhulu, kodwa lapho sishintshana kwakukhona umehluko omncane. Isaga sokuthi izingxenye zabanye abantu zibukeka zinkulu siyiqiniso ngempela.
texts.g:00c76a75: Ukuthemba ukudlala kahle ngemva kwesonto elilodwa kuphela lokufunda isiginci kuyisifiso esikhulu. Awukwazi ukusuthi ngesipunu sokuqala, ngakho masiziqeqeshe kancane kancane.
texts.g:f8203342: Lapho abantu ababili bexabana futhi othile eceleni ephinde avuse intukuthelo yabo, abantu basebenzisa isaga sokuvuthela indlu evuthayo.
texts.g:d26b1edf: Ukuthukuthela namuhla ngoba akukho zithelo ezimbewini ezitshalwe izolo kufana nokufuna itiye lelayisi elishile emthonjeni.
texts.g:6d27989e: Ngisho nomgwaqo owuhamba kaningi ungase ube ushintshile ngenxa yezakhiwo, ngakho kufanele sithathe enhliziyweni iseluleko sokubuza izindlela ngisho nomgwaqo owujwayele.
texts.g:3a277141: Kuphakanyiswe umbono wokweqa ukuhlolwa kokuphepha ukuze kufushaniswe isikhathi sokwakha. Okwamanje kubonakala njengenzuzo ngoba uhlelo luyasondezwa. Kodwa uma ingozi yenzeka, ukwakha kumiswa ngempela izinyanga futhi kulandele ukwabela icala. Isaga sokuthi 'uma ushesha, hamba ngendlela ende' sisebenza ncamashi kulesi simo. texts.g:2dd11ef7: Ekuqeqesheni abasebenzi abasha, izincazelo zabasebenzi abadala ngaso sonke isikhathi zihlangana nenkinga efanayo: noma zichazwe ngokuphelele kangakanani, aziwi kumuntu ongayiboni indawo yomsebenzi. Njengoba isaga sokuthi 'ukuzwa kayikhulu akulingani nokubona kanye' sisho, ukubona umshini usebenza ngamehlo akho kungenza ukuthi izincazelo zamahora ziqondwe ngemizuzu. Lokho akusho ukuthi incazelo ayidingeki. Ukulandelana okusebenza kangcono ukwakha isisekelo sokuqonda ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwendawo yomsebenzi bese ukuhlela ngencazelo.
texts.g:4e66256a: Amapulatifomu amabili amakhulu okulethwa kwempahla akhuphisana ngokunciphisa izimali futhi ahlose ukukhangisa izinzuzo zabanikazi bezitolo. Kodwa uma ukuncintisana sekuphelile, inkampani eyodwa yathenga enye, futhi umqhubi omusha wasusa izinzuzo ebezithenjisiwe. Abaningi bathi ngalokhu, 'Lapho oweyilo belwa, umhlane wamaprawn uyaphuka.' Kodwa lesi siphimiselo sichaza kuphela isimo sokulimala phakathi nokulwa; asihlanganisi isimo ngemva kokuphela kokulwa, lapho onqobile enza amaprawn abe ngumlingani wakhe omusha wokuhweba futhi eshintsha imigomo. Ukulahlekelwa kwabanikazi kufanele kubonwe njengokuvela hhayi ekubanjweni ngengozi kodwa esakhiweni esakhelwe kusukela ekuqaleni ukubenza bancike ohlangothini olulodwa.
texts.g:392498f6: Abantu abagxeka ukuziphatha okukhethekile babiza umcwaningi ongena kuphela emkhakheni owodwa 'ngesele emthonjeni.' Kodwa amanzi aphuma kuphela uma umthombo ujulile. Inkinga yesele akukhona ukuthi lihlala emthonjeni kodwa ukuthi alikwazi ukucabanga isibhakabhaka esibanzi ngaphandle kwawo. Umcwaningi owazi imingcele yomkhakha wakhe uyakhuluma namasele aphakathi kwemithombo eyahlukene, aletha imibuzo emisha, futhi asebenzisa leyo mibuzo ukumba umthombo wakhe uphinde ujule. Ngakho okudingekayo akukhona ukugcwalisa imithombo kodwa ukwakha izindlela phakathi kwayo.
texts.g:259c83de: Ngokomibiko wesikhungo semfuyo yamasiko, ngaphezu kwengxenye yezindawo ezitholakele eminyakeni eyishumi edlule zavela ngengozi ngenkathi kumbiwa umhlaba ukwakha izakhiwo ezintsha. Abantu bebecabanga ukuthi sebevele bazi konke ngomhlaba ongaphansi kwenhloko-dolobha ngoba nje useduze. Isisho esithi 'Kumnyama ngaphansi kwesibani' sikhomba ubumnyama obuvela hhayi ngoba izinto azibonakali kodwa ngoba akekho ozama ukubheka. texts.g:a8777528: Kukhona inkolelo evamile yokuthi uma iphrojekthi yocwaningo ehlanganyelwe inabaphathi abaningi, izinto ziyaphosha. texts.g:1f6577ed: Kuyaphawulwa ukuthi iningi lamalungu ekomiti lokubuyekeza liyizikhulu ezisebenze isikhathi eside embonini ebuyekezwayo.
