texts.g:5f920bc3: Imiphumela engenakubalwa; wonke umuntu nakho konke kuhlukile
texts.g:06d330f8: Ukungabi namandla, ungenayo indlela yokubhekana nesimo
texts.g:a50f326c: Ukuba nobuso obubili; ingaphandle lakho liyehluka nengaphakathi
texts.g:bc110a30: Imboni yashiswa yaphela futhi wonke amathuluzi ayo ashintshwa, futhi ngenxa yalokho isivinini sokukhiqiza saphindeka kabili, ngakho kuyiqiniso ngokoqobo ukuthi ngokubi kuvela okuhle.
texts.g:93a72436: Njalo ngoNyaka Omusha ngiphikelela ekuzivivinyeni, kodwa njengoba ngingahlali ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezintathu, izinqumo zami zihlala zinyamalala ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa.
texts.g:8138c19a: Ukuhamba uya emsebenzini ngebhayisikili kukunikeza ukuzivivinya futhi kongela imali yokugibela, ngakho kubulala izinyoni ezimbili ngetshe linye.
texts.g:1ca73e05: Lowo owephule isithembiso wathukuthela esikhundleni sokuxolisa, okuyilapho isela ligxeka ohlukunyeziwe ngokweqile.
texts.g:50a57c06: Kuthiwa ukuzivivinya kuyasiza umzimba, kodwa ukwenza amahora ayishumi ngosuku ngempela kuyakugulisa, ngakho isisho sokuthi okweqile kubi njengokuntula siyiqiniso.
texts.g:bd35520a: Izinkampani ezimbili zikhetha ngayinye kuphela izingxenye ezizilungele zezibalo ezifanayo futhi ziphikisana ngokuzizuzisa.
texts.g:dd6e0f5b: Lapho umfundi etholakala ngemiphumela engcono kunothisha, uthisha wajabula wathi umfundi usedlule inkosi yakhe.
texts.g:45b7572e: Ukucwaninga ukwakheka kwezindlu zakudala ze-hanok nokusebenzisa lokho ekwakhiweni kwanamuhla kuwumbonelo omuhle wokufunda okusha kokudala.
texts.g:abb02c4f: Abasebenzi bokuhlenga baqhubeka nokusesha emini nasebusuku ukuze bathole abantu abalahlekile.
texts.g:966842b0: Muva nje, abantu abaningi bayalahlekelwa imali eningi ngemva kokukhohliswa yizinkulumo ezimnandi ezithembisa 'inkokhelo eyisisekelo eqinisekisiwe nenzuzo yenyanga ngenyanga engama-20%'. Ekutshalweni kwemali okujwayelekile, uma inzuzo inkulu, ingozi iba nkulu. Isethembiso senzuzo ephezulu ngaphandle kobungozi kufanele sisolwe ngenxa yalokho kanye. Kunokuba sikhohliswe amazwi amnandi futhi sishashe, sidinga umkhuba wokuqala sibheke ukuthi inkampani ibhalisiwe esikhungweni esisemthethweni yini.
texts.g:36da0494: Inkampani yokudla yafihla iphutha lomkhiqizo eliyaziyo, kodwa umlandisi wangaphakathi wagcina ephumile obala ngakho konke. Abantu abaningi baphendula ngenduduzo, besho ukuthi ubulungisa buhlale bunqoba. Kodwa iqiniso lokuthi umphumela uphindisiwe akusho ukuthi inqubo nayo yayilungile. Bekukhona abathengi abalimele, futhi uma uhlelo lokubhekela belukhululekile iqiniso lingase lisale lifihliwe. Ubulungisa obunqobayo abuzenzekeli ngokwabo; kuyenzeka kuphela uma izikhungo nesibindi kuwusekela.
texts.g:acf2b5ae: Isisho sokuthi okuningi kungcono singase sifanele izinto, kodwa kunzima ukusisebenzisa olwazini njengoba lunjalo. Ngempahla eningi, izisekelo zokwahlulela zibonakala zikhula, kodwa empeleni isikhathi nomzamo odingekayo ukuhlunga okudingekayo nakho kuyakhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma impahla engacacile umsuka ixubene, isiphetho singase sibe nezinkimbinkimbi ngempela. Okubalulekile akukhona ukuthi uqoqe kangakanani kodwa ukuthi ukhetha futhi usebenzisa kahle kangakanani impahla ethembekile.
texts.g:099e31d2: Abantu abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi ngesikhathi sokwehla komnotho bavame ukunikezwa induduzo ngomusho othi 'Saeongjima.' Isho ukuthi okuhle nokubi kokuphila akunakubikezelwa, ngakho izinsuku ezinhle zizofika uma ulinda. Ixhegu endabeni nalo alizange lunqume ngokweqile ngenhlanhla enhle noma embi ngesikhathi ihhashi lalo ligijima nalapho libuya. Kodwa lo musho awusho ukuhlala ungenzi lutho ulinde inhlanhla. Amazwi enduduzo awakwazi ukufaka esikhundleni izinyathelo. Okudingwa abangasebenzi, kanye nesimo sokwamukela ngokuthula ukungaqiniseki, ukwesekwa okuqondile okufana nokuqeqeshwa kabusha nokuvikelwa kwemali engenayo.
texts.g:52aa979d: Lapho inkampani ihlongoza uhlelo lokubuyekeza olugcina inani eliphelele leholo lonyaka linjalo kodwa lukhuphula isabelo semiklomelo yokusebenza esikhundleni sokwehlisa iholo eliyisisekelo, inyunyana yaphikisa, ibiza ngokuthi 'Josammosa.' Izinkawu endabeni zazisiphukuphuku ngoba zaphuthelwa iqiniso lokuthi, kungaba ntathu ekuseni noma ezine, kwakuyisikhombisa ngosuku. Kodwa lolu hlelo lunezinguquko ezingekho endabeni yezinkawu. Imiklomelo ingancipha kuye ngemiphumela yenkampani, futhi iholo eliyisisekelo liyisilinganiso sokukhokhelwa ekuphumeni nokuhlolwa kwezikweletu. Ngisho noma izibalo ezipheleleyo zibukeka zifana, uma lowo othwala ingozi eshintsha, kunzima ukukuchitha njengeJosammosa.
texts.g:cdec0eb0: Umkhosi wasekhaya uphumelele ekuheheni izivakashi, futhi izivakashi ziyanda unyaka ngamunye. Kodwa imicimbi enokubamba iqhaza kwezakhamuzi yehlile futhi inkundla yashintshela ekugxileni kubadlali bangaphandle. Ngalolu shintsho, kuvela ukugxekwa 'kokuphenduka kwemvikeli nesivakashi.' Umnikazi womkhosi kufanele kube yizakhamuzi ezinakekele isiko lawo, kodwa ukunambitha kwezivakashi kuze kwanquma okuqukethwe umcimbi. Kodwa umuntu akakwazi ukusola ukwanda kwezivakashi uqobo. Inkinga ukuthi, ngesizathu sokwamukela izivakashi, umnikazi uphoqelekile ukuphuma endaweni yakhe. Impumelelo yomkhosi kufanele ihlolwe hhayi ngenani lezivakashi kodwa ngokuthi izakhamuzi zisamile maphakathi nenkundla.
texts.g:17a6db45: Abantu abaningi bacaphuna 'Daegi-manseong' ngokumelene nombono wokukhetha izingane ezinesiphiwo kusenesikhathi. Bathi njengoba kunamathalente aqhakaza sekwephuzile, akufanele ahlelwe kusenesikhathi. Kodwa le mpikiswano nayo inesikhala. Ngoba i-Daegi-manseong ikhuluma ngomphumela wesitsha esikhulu esiphela sekwephuzile, ayisitsheli ngezimo ezingenakubalwa ezalindela ukuqhakaza sekwephuzile futhi azange. Ukuqoqa izindaba zempumelelo kuphela ukuxoxa ngesikhathi sokukhetha akwanele njengesizathu. Okufanele kuhlolwe esikhundleni salokho ukuthi ukukhetha kuphela ngomjikelezo owodwa noma amathuba avulwa futhi kamuva.
texts.g:ef984356: Nanini uma kuvela imibono yokunciphisa isabelomali sokuzivivinya kokubhekana nezinhlekelele, isisho esithi 'Yubi-muhwan' siyasetshenziswa njengomqondo wokuphikisa. Lesi sisho asilungile kodwa asinakho ukukholisa okukhulu. Uma ukulungiselela kuphumelela, akukho okwenzekayo, ngakho impumelelo yako ayihlali njengomcimbi obonakalayo. Iqiniso lokuthi akubanga khona ingozi lingaba obunye ubufakazi bokuthi ukuzivivinya bekusebenza, noma ubufakazi bokuthi ukuzivivinya bekungadingekile kusukela ekuqaleni. Ngakho, ukukholisa abaphethe isabelomali, okudingekayo hhayi isiqubulo kodwa idatha elinganisela ukulimala okungabe kwenzeka ngaphandle kokuzivivinya.
texts.g:7d9c642e: Umkhiqizi wenze isikhangiso esikhulu sokukhuthaza ukuphatha okuthandwa yimvelo, nokho amadokhumenti akhe okudalula athi ukukhishwa kwegesi yokufudumeza umhlaba kukhuphukile ngesikhathi esifanayo. Kulula ukukubiza ngokuthi 'Pyori-budong.' Kodwa i-Pyori-budong ichaza ukuthi ingaphandle nengaphakathi kuyehluka, futhi ukusho lokho umuntu kufanele azi ingaphakathi. Uma isikhangiso sichaza uhlelo lokunciphisa ukukhishwa futhi uhlelo lusesigabeni sokuqalisa, igebe nezibalo zamanje lingaba ukubambezeleka kwesikhathi hhayi inkohliso. Isinqumo kufanele senziwe ngemva kokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lokunciphisa lucace kangakanani nokuthi luyenziwa njengoba kuthenjisiwe.
texts.g:5b588c16: Ithimba elisebenze ndawonye isikhathi eside liyavumelana ngaphandle kokukhuluma. Abantu bakubiza ngokuthi 'Isim-jeonsim' futhi bakuthatha njengokubambisana okuhle kakhulu. Kodwa le ndlela inendleko. Izindinganiso ezabelwana ngokuthula azishiywa emadokhumentini, ngakho ziyanyamalala zonke ngesikhathi uma amalungu eshintsha. Futhi, inkolelo yokuthi 'siyazi ngaphandle kokusho' ngisho isusa ithuba lokudalula ukuthi ngamunye uziqonda ngokwehlukile izinto. I-Isim-jeonsim ibonisa amandla ayo kuphela esisekelweni lapho izindinganiso ezibalulekile sezibhalwe phansi.
texts.g:c86776f8: Iphrojekthi yayinomcimbi omkhulu wokuqala kodwa cishe ayinawo umphumela, ngakho yagcina isinyamalele.
texts.g:af636628: Njengoba amanani ezinto ezingavuthiwe ekhuphuka futhi nezinga lokushintshaniswa manje alingazinzile, isimo sokushaywa ngokulandelana, inkampani yabambezela uhlelo lwayo lokutshala imali.
texts.g:383161c6: Abahluleli banikeze amamaki aphezulu ngoba umuntu ocelayo uhlale ethule futhi waphatha ngisho imibuzo engalindelekile ngokuzivumelanisa ngaleso sikhathi.
texts.g:efbd5c64: Abaphikisi bayabheka ngokulangazela ithuba lokuthatha isabelo sethu semakethe, ngakho lesi asiyona isikhathi sokuphumula.
texts.g:96c6433c: Isazi saziwa njengomuntu owaziyo kabanzi onolwazi olujulile hhayi kuphela ngomlando kodwa nangezinkanyezi nokwelashwa.
texts.g:fac27988: Umoya womhlangano wehla ngenxa yombiko owugwema umongo wombuzo wakhuluma ngezindaba ezingahlangene.
texts.g:40dc49d8: Isimo sokungabi nasinqumo sokuhlehlisa izinqumo nokuphendula imibono kwenza kube nzima ukuzuza ukwethembana kwamalungu eqembu.
texts.g:05e2223f: Uma lenkontileka ingaphumeleli, inkampani ebambisana nayo cishe izoyeka nokuthengiselana.
